problem_description: In remap_metavar_names (llvm/utils/UpdateTestChecks/common.py), referencing new_color.color instead of new_color.mapping causes an unhandled AttributeError exception when an uncommitted meta-variable appears multiple times on the same line during test check generation.

In handleNonPreemptibleIfunc (lld/ELF/Relocations.cpp), requesting an AUTH GOT entry for a non-preemptible IFUNC symbol triggers an assertion failure in debug builds or silently generates an invalid non-authenticated GOT entry in release builds instead of reporting an unsupported relocation error.

In CoroutineStmtBuilder::makeNewAndDeleteExpr (clang/lib/Sema/SemaCoroutine.cpp), when the secondary lookup for an aligned operator new fails after a previous successful unaligned lookup, OperatorNew is not cleared, causing clang to retain the unaligned function while marking alignment as required and producing a false parameter count mismatch error.

In checkZOptions (lld/ELF/Driver.cpp), -z argument validation occurs before target configuration code processes and claims -z rel and -z rela, causing the linker to issue spurious unknown option warnings for valid -z rel and -z rela command-line flags.

In Rematerializer::isRegIdenticalAtUses (llvm/lib/CodeGen/Rematerializer.cpp), LI.getVNInfoAt(RefSlot) can return a null pointer when a register has no value definition at the given slot, causing an unconditional dereference of DefVN and a segmentation fault crash.

In emitSCSEpilogue (llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVFrameLowering.cpp), the instruction iterator passed into the function can equal MBB.end(), causing an invalid iterator dereference and assertion failure or crash when querying MI->getOpcode().

In llvm::computeLTOCacheKey (llvm/lib/LTO/LTO.cpp), iteration over DefinedGlobals without sorting entries by GUID causes ThinLTO cache keys to depend non-deterministically on the module insertion order, resulting in cache misses.

In SymbolizerProcess::ReadFromSymbolizer (compiler-rt/lib/sanitizer_common/sanitizer_symbolizer_libcdep.cpp), a locally declared ret variable shadows the outer return variable, causing an EOF condition from ReadFromFile to be silently ignored and misreported as a successful read, which triggers an abort on an empty buffer.

In llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVRegisterInfo.td, the DwarfRegAlias definitions for capability registers X10_Y through X15_Y incorrectly alias X0 through X5 instead of X10 through X15, producing incorrect DWARF register numbers in generated unwind tables.

In MCExpr::evaluateAsRelocatableImpl (llvm/lib/MC/MCExpr.cpp), the inequality expression evaluation mistakenly compares the right operand against itself rather than comparing the left operand against the right operand, causing assembler inequality comparisons between different registers to erroneously evaluate to false (0).
In lldb/source/Host/freebsd/Host.cpp, invoking GetCString() on a FileSpec component that had been changed to return llvm::StringRef causes a compilation error when building LLDB on FreeBSD.

In shouldEmitConstantsToTextSection (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/Utils/AMDGPUBaseInfo.cpp), the target check tests only for Triple::AMDPAL and omits R600 targets (Triple::r600), causing constant data for R600 architectures to be emitted into the .rodata section instead of .text.

In TokenAnnotator::parseParens (clang/lib/Format/TokenAnnotator.cpp), PrevNonComment is dereferenced to call isTypeName without checking for a null pointer, causing a null pointer dereference crash when formatting an opening parenthesis that has no preceding non-comment token on its line.

In LSRInstance::Expand (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/LoopStrengthReduce.cpp), pointer-to-integer conversion for ICmpZero comparisons is evaluated with the pointer operand's effective type before computing the induction variable arithmetic type IntTy, generating type-mismatched icmp instructions when a loop contains pointer induction variables of differing widths.

In adjustRelativeBranch (llvm/lib/Target/AVR/MCTargetDesc/AVRAsmBackend.cpp), the PC-relative jump offset calculation right-shifts the byte difference without subtracting the 2-byte program counter pre-increment inherent to AVR relative jump and branch instructions, producing jump targets that are off by two bytes.

In SymbolicateCrashLog (lldb/examples/python/crashlog.py), referencing self.crashlog within a standalone function instead of the crash_log argument causes an unhandled NameError crash when symbolicating crash logs with the -c (--crashed-only) option.

In HandleProcedureName (flang/lib/Semantics/resolve-names.cpp), identifiers referenced in an OpenMP DECLARE_TARGET directive are unconditionally treated as implicitly declaring external procedures, causing valid subsequent explicit variable declarations in the same scope to be rejected with duplicate declaration errors.

In X86TTIImpl::getArithmeticInstrCost (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86TargetTransformInfo.cpp), omitting v16i16 and v32i16 entries from AVX512BWUniformConstCostTable causes uniform constant vector shifts on AVX-512BW to bypass fast table lookup and fall through to non-uniform cost models, overestimating throughput cost.

In opencl-c.h and OpenCLBuiltins.td, the intel_sub_group_block_write_ui family of built-in functions declare their image2d_t parameter with a read_only access qualifier instead of write_only, preventing write operations to writable images.

In DeduceTemplateArgumentsByTypeMatch (clang/lib/Sema/SemaTemplateDeduction.cpp), failing to unwrap PackExpansionType to its underlying pattern when retaining type sugar causes template argument deduction against pack expansion arguments during partial ordering to fail.

In polly/lib/CodeGen/IslNodeBuilder.cpp, invalidating ScalarEvolution caches prior to code generation forces SCEV re-analysis while the CFG and SSA are in an inconsistent intermediate state, causing assertion failures and crashes during Polly code generation.

In llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCISelLowering.cpp, lowering scalar i128 comparisons into vector v16i8 vcmpequb comparisons reuses the original load's MachineMemOperand unmodified, attaching scalar i128 !range metadata to a vector load where range metadata is invalid.

In VPBlendRecipe::execute (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlan.h), an invalid assertion requires blend recipes to have more than one incoming value, triggering an assertion failure when vectorizing a phi node that has only a single incoming predecessor with a mask.

In BasicAAResult::DecomposeGEPExpression (llvm/lib/Analysis/BasicAliasAnalysis.cpp), traversing through llvm.ptrmask intrinsics without verifying offset preservation treats masked pointers as having identical byte offsets to their arguments, yielding invalid symbolic offsets and unsound NoAlias determinations.
In StringRef::count (llvm/lib/Support/StringRef.cpp), passing an empty search pattern matches at index i and increments i by Str.size() (zero), causing an infinite loop.

In RawComment::getFormattedText (clang/lib/AST/RawCommentList.cpp), the trailing newline stripping loop calls back() and pop_back() on a std::string without checking whether the string is empty, causing undefined behavior and crashes on empty comment strings.

In Constant::toConstantRange (llvm/lib/IR/Constants.cpp), the ConstantVector evaluation path verifies that each element is a ConstantInt or ConstantByte but unconditionally dereferences the ConstantInt pointer, causing a null pointer dereference crash when encountering a ConstantByte.

In compiler-rt/lib/sanitizer_common/sanitizer_redefine_builtins.h, internal sanitizer built-in symbol aliases are unconditionally defined with .set sym, val syntax on all non-Apple/non-Windows targets, causing compilation failures on architectures such as Alpha where .set is reserved for assembler mode flags.

In LoopVectorizationPlanner::plan (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp), failing to return std::nullopt early when VPlans is empty causes a compiler crash when querying plan vector factors on loops where legality checks prevent building any vector plans.

In createDiagnostics (clang/tools/diagtool/ShowEnabledWarnings.cpp), TextDiagnosticBuffer is dynamically allocated via new without transferring ownership to DiagnosticsEngine or any smart pointer, leaving the buffer unreachable and leaking memory on every invocation.

In Library::printf (llvm/tools/llubi/lib/Library.cpp), the character format specifier %c is constructed with an ll length modifier, producing the invalid format specifier %llc and triggering sanitizer runtime errors.

In ProcessFreeBSDKernelCore::DoUpdateThreadList (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/FreeBSD-Kernel-Core/ProcessFreeBSDKernelCore.cpp), traversing the FreeBSD kernel allproc list in reverse order assumes that processes are stored in monotonic PID order, producing incorrectly ordered thread and process lists when PIDs have been recycled.

In CodeGenPrepare::tryToSinkFreeOperands (llvm/lib/CodeGen/CodeGenPrepare.cpp), the instruction position map is repeatedly rebuilt by linearly scanning the entire basic block for each candidate instruction, creating quadratic algorithmic complexity that causes massive compile-time slowdowns on large basic blocks.

In addAliasScopeMetadata (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/AMDGPULowerKernelArguments.cpp), memory-accessing call instructions that have no pointer operands are skipped without receiving !noalias metadata, causing MemorySSA to treat them as clobbers and preventing scalarization of uniform loads.

In UnwrapTypeForDebugInfo (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGDebugInfo.cpp), omitting Type::CountAttributed handling prevents desugaring CountAttributedType, causing a compiler crash during debug metadata emission when compiling declarations annotated with __attribute__((__counted_by__(...))) with debug info enabled.

In llvm/lib/Target/Hexagon/HexagonHazardRecognizer.cpp and llvm/include/llvm/Target/Target.td, the Hexagon hazard recognizer treats RELOC_NONE meta-instructions as regular instructions requiring hardware resource reservation, causing the instruction scheduler to enter an infinite loop.

In Driver::inferOffloadToolchains (clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp), duplicate target triples are repeatedly inserted into a multiset when multiple offload target architectures are specified, causing spurious toolchain diagnostic warnings during compilation.

In SelectionDAG::computeConstantRangeIncludingKnownBits (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAG.cpp), the ForSigned argument is omitted when calling computeConstantRange, causing the integer Depth parameter to be implicitly converted to boolean, while visitIMINMAX unconditionally passes ForSigned=false even for signed operations, producing incorrect constant ranges.

In BoUpSLP::buildTree_rec (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/SLPVectorizer.cpp), the ordered reduction worklist enqueues candidate instructions repeatedly when switching to ordered mode without checking whether they were previously visited, causing cyclic re-evaluation and an infinite loop on complex reduction chains.

In clang/include/clang/AST/ExternalASTSource.h, PointerLikeTypeTraits for LazyGenerationalUpdatePtr computes NumLowBitsAvailable based on T rather than the underlying PointerUnion, overclaiming available low bits on 32-bit platforms where LazyData* has only 2 low bits while Decl* has 3, leading to pointer corruption or assertion failures.

In ProcessFreeBSDKernelCore::DoLoadCore (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/FreeBSD-Kernel-Core/ProcessFreeBSDKernelCore.cpp), printing unread kernel message buffer entries is guarded by a check for interactive mode that evaluates to false during core loading, preventing kernel panic messages from being displayed.

In Expr::isKnownToHaveBooleanValue() (clang/lib/AST/Expr.cpp), treating unsigned 1-bit bitfields as semantically boolean causes Sema::ActOnFinishSwitchStmt() to emit a false-positive -Wswitch-bool warning when switching on a 1-bit unsigned bitfield member.

In compiler-rt/lib/builtins/arm/aeabi_u{read,write}*.S, omitting NO_EXEC_STACK_DIRECTIVE results in missing .note.GNU-stack ELF sections, causing binaries linking these builtins to require an executable stack.

In AArch64_ELFTargetObjectFile::getIndirectSymViaGOTPCRel (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64TargetObjectFile.cpp), relative vtable specifiers are created as MCSymbolRefExpr instances with S_PLT or S_GOTPCREL rather than MCSpecifierExpr, causing the assembly printer to emit legacy @-specifier syntax and produce incorrect relocation types in data directives.

In RegisterContextFreeBSDKernelCore_arm64::ReadRegister (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/FreeBSD-Kernel-Core/RegisterContextFreeBSDKernelCore_arm64.cpp), reading gpr_pc_arm64 accesses the PCB with the index reg - gpr_x19_arm64, which offsets to the stack pointer field instead of the link register field, causing the program counter to display the stack pointer value.

In CoroutineStmtBuilder::makeNewAndDeleteExpr (clang/lib/Sema/SemaCoroutine.cpp), when a coroutine promise class imports operator new or operator delete from a base class via C++ inheritance declarations without providing a local function declaration, the compiler frontend crashes during allocation function resolution.

In getHexagonPacketOffset() (lld/ELF/Relocations.cpp), reading instruction words using memcpy() into host uint32_t assumes the host has the same endianness as the Hexagon target, causing endianness corruption and incorrect packet end boundary detection on big-endian hosts.

In Driver::BuildOffloadingActions() (clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp), sorting toolchain-architecture pairs using llvm::sort with a comparator that only checks the architecture string causes non-deterministic ordering between distinct toolchains sharing the same target architecture.

In Sema::BuildCXXNestedNameSpecifier (clang/lib/Sema/SemaCXXScopeSpec.cpp), error recovery invokes ExtendNestedNameSpecifier when name lookup falls back to ordinary lookup results instead of restricted nested name specifier results, causing an assertion failure in ASTContext::getTypeDeclType.

In MCDwarfFrameEmitter::Emit() (llvm/lib/MC/MCDwarf.cpp), early returning when compact unwind information does not require an EH frame section bypasses resetting UseAssemblerInfoForParsing to true, leaving the streamer in an invalid state for subsequent frame emissions.

In SystemZ::getRelExpr (lld/ELF/Arch/SystemZ.cpp), R_390_TLS_LDO32 and R_390_TLS_LDO64 relocations in non-allocated sections like .debug_info are unhandled, triggering unhandled relocation errors when linking debug info with TLS references.

In RadixTree::findOrCreate (llvm/include/llvm/ADT/RadixTree.h), default-constructed singular iterators of the root node's key are passed into std::mismatch, violating iterator range preconditions and triggering debug STL assertion aborts under _GLIBCXX_DEBUG.

In VPlanTransforms::handleUncountableEarlyExits (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlanTransforms.cpp), the sort comparator evaluates VPDT.dominates(A, B) which returns true when comparing an element to itself, violating strict weak ordering irreflexivity and causing std::sort assertion aborts under _GLIBCXX_DEBUG.

In VPlanTransforms::transformtoPartialReduction (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlanTransforms.cpp), the pass fails to verify that the exit select corresponds to the exit users and applies it to intermediate links in the reduction chain, causing miscompilations in vectorized partial reduction loops.

In setConfigs() (lld/ELF/Driver.cpp), omitting the negation operator in checkDynamicRelocsDefault inverts the target architecture filter, disabling dynamic relocation consistency checking on supported ELF architectures while enabling it on architectures lacking Elf_Rel addend support.

In libunwind/src/UnwindRegistersSave.S, gating the 64-bit PowerPC __unw_getcontext implementation with defined(__powerpc__) rather than defined(__powerpc64__) causes 32-bit PowerPC targets to select the 64-bit register saving routines.

In mlir/lib/Conversion/MemRefToSPIRV/MemRefToSPIRV.cpp, the element type verification for memref alloc and dealloc lowering patterns omits complex types, causing pattern matching to fail when converting memrefs containing complex element types to SPIR-V.

In libcxx/include/type_traits, a missing closing angle bracket in the fallback definition of is_void (remove_cv<_Tp::type) causes compilation syntax errors when compiling with compilers that do not provide the __is_void builtin.
In lld, [LLD] Merge .hexagon.attributes sections (#148098).

In Driver::ConstructPhaseAction (clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp), compilation for AMD SPIR-V targets expects an assembler phase that is unsupported due to the lack of an external assembler, causing regular C/C++ source compilation targeting spirv64-amd-amdhsa to fail.

In LoopVectorizationPlanner::precomputeCosts (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp), instructions having users outside the loop are not excluded from exit condition cost precomputation, leading to compiler crashes during vectorization planning.

In lldb/source/Core/Debugger.cpp, the default frame format string omits a space between the PC address and function name when a frame has no associated module, causing the address and function name to run together without whitespace.

In IOHandlerEditline::IOHandlerEditline (lldb/source/Core/IOHandler.cpp), use_editline only checks that output and error streams are non-null without verifying that their underlying files possess valid FILE* streams, causing assertion failures or null pointer crashes in Editline initialization.

In hasDeferredEmission (mlir/lib/Target/Cpp/TranslateToCpp.cpp), emitc::DereferenceOp is omitted from the set of operations with deferred emission, causing dereference operations to be emitted eagerly as standalone variable assignments rather than inline deferred expressions.

In AMDGPUTargetInfo::setSupportedOpenCLOpts (clang/lib/Basic/Targets/AMDGPU.h), reorganizing OpenCL 3.0 feature macros omits the __opencl_c_read_write_images feature macro from AMDGPU target options, causing compilation failures when building ROCm device libraries.

In getFileRange (clang/lib/Tooling/Transformer/SourceCode.cpp), source ranges spanning across a macro boundary where one token is inside a macro argument and the other outside are not rejected, returning invalid partial ranges containing unclosed parentheses or incomplete macro invocation syntax.

In RegisterCoalescer::applyTerminalRule (llvm/lib/CodeGen/RegisterCoalescer.cpp), the loop checking for subsequent instruction interference erroneously passes &Copy instead of &MI to isMoveInstr, causing the function to check the original copy instruction repeatedly rather than scanning subsequent instructions.

In LLD linker entry points (lld::coff::link, lld::elf::link, lld::mingw::link, lld::wasm::link), calling enableColors() before updating the global lld::stderrOS pointer results in color diagnostics modifying llvm::errs() or dereferencing a dangling stream pointer from a prior linker invocation.

In clang/include/clang/Basic/TokenKinds.def, defining char8_t as a CXX20_KEYWORD rather than a standard KEYWORD with CHAR8SUPPORT causes the char8_t keyword to remain unconditionally enabled in C++20 mode even when -fno-char8_t is specified.

In CompilerInstanceWithContext::initialize (clang/lib/Tooling/DependencyScanning/DependencyScannerImpl.cpp), DiagEngineWithCmdAndOpts is constructed with OverlayFS before initVFSForByNameScanning initializes OverlayFS, passing an uninitialized VFS reference and causing null pointer dereference crashes.

In ASTWriter::GenerateNameLookupTable (clang/lib/Serialization/ASTWriter.cpp), when processing enum constants from C++20 header units, getTopLevelOwningNamedModule() returns null, causing an unconditional call to isNamedModule() to crash with a null pointer dereference.

In CommonSPIRTargetCodeGenInfo::getNullPointer (clang/lib/CodeGen/Targets/SPIR.cpp), null pointers in constant address space are materialized via addrspacecast from the generic address space, violating OpenCL/SPIR-V specifications because generic address space does not cover constant address space.

In AsmLexer::LexToken (llvm/lib/MC/MCParser/AsmLexer.cpp), when checking for multi-character comment prefixes on targets supporting both single and double comment characters, encountering a single comment character at the end of a line causes the lexer to consume two characters across the newline, inadvertently eating the newline and treating the next code line as a comment.

In LowerUINT_TO_FP_i64 (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), calling shouldUseHorizontalOp without verifying Subtarget.hasSSE3() emits X86ISD::FHADD when optimizing for code size on SSE2 targets lacking SSE3 instructions.

In ToDwarfSourceLanguage (lldb/source/Target/Language.cpp), the boundary check for standard language enumerators checks < eLanguageTypeLastStandardLanguage instead of <=, causing languages equal to the last standard language (such as Mojo) to be rejected with std::nullopt.

In NativeProcessLinux::AddPtraceScopeNote (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/Linux/NativeProcessLinux.cpp), error instances returned from inspecting ptrace_scope are left unchecked on certain return paths, triggering fatal assertion failures in the llvm::Error destructor for unconsumed errors.

In llvm/include/llvm/CodeGen/ValueTypes.td, the cPTR wildcard pseudo value type definition omits isNormalValueType = false, causing MVT::VALUETYPE_SIZE to expand from 256 to 504 and quadratically bloating memory-critical backend classes like TargetLoweringBase to 1.5 MB each.

In DumpModuleInfoAction::ExecuteAction (clang/lib/Frontend/FrontendActions.cpp), macro definitions from module files are printed by iterating over an unordered hash map, producing non-deterministic output order in -module-file-info invocations across runs.

In llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPC.td, the 32-bit e5500 CPU definition is configured with the Feature64Bit flag rather than Feature64BitSupport, incorrectly enabling 64-bit code generation modes for a 32-bit CPU.

In llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ExpandPseudo.cpp and X86InstrCompiler.td, tail calls to loaded pointers through memory reference i64mem_TC without accounting for Win64-specific register constraints, causing registers clobbered across the tail call return to be selected.

In BPFDAGToDAGISel::PreprocessISelDAG (llvm/lib/Target/BPF/BPFISelDAGToDAG.cpp), inspecting unlinked MachineInstr PHI nodes during the DAG-to-DAG selection phase erroneously eliminates narrowing bitwise-AND masks when values are updated across loop back-edges.

In decodeRelCondBrTarget7 and decodeRelCondBrTarget13 (llvm/lib/Target/AVR/Disassembler/AVRDisassembler.cpp), negative signed displacement values produced by SignExtend32 are shifted left with the << operator, triggering undefined behavior for negative operand left-shifts under C++ standards.

In llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/FLATInstructions.td and AMDGPU.td, instruction selection patterns match saddr flat atomic pseudo-instructions that lack corresponding hardware instruction encodings on GFX9, causing compiler crashes during MC instruction lowering.

In MicrosoftCXXNameMangler::mangleUnqualifiedName (clang/lib/AST/MicrosoftMangle.cpp), retrieving cached template argument manglings for eleventh and subsequent function arguments omits the trailing @ delimiter, generating corrupted MSVC ABI symbol names.

In DumpEnumValue (lldb/source/Symbol/ClangASTContext.cpp), printing non-matching non-bitfield enumeration values using %PRIi64 without checking qual_type->isSignedIntegerOrEnumerationType() causes unsigned enum constants to be displayed as negative numbers.

In Clang::DumpCompilationDatabase (clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Clang.cpp), negating the llvm::sys::fs::current_path error code check causes the working directory path to be overwritten with . whenever fetching the current directory succeeds.

In TreeTransform::TransformDeclRefExpr (clang/lib/Sema/TreeTransform.h), omitting a comparison between the transformed Found declaration and E->getFoundDecl() causes the existing DeclRefExpr to be preserved even when name lookup resolves to a different shadow declaration.

In X86TargetLowering::LowerINSERT_VECTOR_ELT (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), passing DAG.getConstant rather than DAG.getTargetConstant for the immediate mask operand of X86ISD::BLENDI triggers an assertion failure during instruction selection.

In Sema::AddOverloadCandidate (clang/lib/Sema/SemaOverload.cpp), the perfect match short-circuit optimization incorrectly assumes a template specialization with a perfect argument match is strictly better than a non-template non-perfect match candidate, violating C++ overload ranking rules.

In X86TargetLowering::EmitInstrWithCustomInserter (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), scanning backwards past CMPXCHG8B glued register definitions decrements past the basic block start, and modifying address operands with setReg/setImm crashes when operands are frame indices or globals.

In isDereferenceableAndAlignedInLoop (llvm/lib/Analysis/Loads.cpp), when the exact loop backedge-taken count is uncomputable in loops with early exits, the analysis fails to fall back to the constant maximum backedge-taken count, causing valid dereferenceable memory accesses across loop iterations to be rejected.

In VPlanTransforms::unroll (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlanUnroll.cpp), cloning a VPReplicateRecipe during unrolling fails to copy the poison-generating flags from the original recipe to the clone, causing unrolled instructions to retain unsafe arithmetic wrap flags from the base instruction.

In Lexer::LexDependencyDirectiveToken (clang/lib/Lex/Lexer.cpp), when a fatal module loader error occurs inside a submodule, cutOffLexing() is ignored because BufferPtr < BufferEnd, causing the lexer to continue lexing in an invalid preprocessor state and crash.

In DirectoryLookup::LookupFile and HeaderSearch::LookupFile (clang/lib/Lex/HeaderSearch.cpp), remapping header lookups to absolute target paths leaves the mapping indicator unset, preventing the suppression of -Wnonportable-include-path warnings.

In clang-tools-extra/modularize/Modularize.cpp, Location::operator bool is declared without explicit, causing C++20 three-way comparison (operator<=>) synthesized by std::tie to implicitly compare locations as booleans rather than by filename and line numbers.

In MemoryAccessRangeT (compiler-rt/lib/tsan/rtl/tsan_rtl_access.cpp), calculating the shadow end address without accounting for kShadowCell alignment leads to underestimating the shadow boundary, failing to clear or instrument the tail end of the memory access range.

In COFFWriter::write (llvm/lib/ObjCopy/COFF/COFFWriter.cpp), section names are registered into StringTableBuilder without priority, causing section names to be positioned after symbol strings and resulting in 7+ digit offsets that broke debugger compatibility with GDB and LLDB.

In Sema::BuildCXXFunctionalCastExpr (clang/lib/Sema/SemaCast.cpp), setting parenthesis ranges on CXXConstructExpr overwrites the right parenthesis location of inner sub-expressions, corrupting the source range of nested constructor expressions such as A(A(1, 2)).

In llvm/lib/ExecutionEngine/Orc/Core.cpp, failing to notify queries waiting on emitted-but-not-ready symbols when their dependencies fail materialization causes asynchronous symbol queries to hang indefinitely in a deadlock state.

In ThreadSanitizer::instrumentAtomic (llvm/lib/Transforms/Instrumentation/ThreadSanitizer.cpp), replacing instructions via Instruction::replaceAllUsesWith without erasing the original instruction leaves dead load atomic instructions in the IR after instrumentation.

In GNUStyle<ELFT>::printNotes and LLVMStyle<ELFT>::printNotes (llvm/tools/llvm-readobj/ELFDumper.cpp), invoking ->empty() on Obj->sections() without checking the llvm::Expected return value triggers an unhandled Error assertion failure.

In getFramePointerKind (clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Clang.cpp), evaluating -momit-leaf-frame-pointer only inside the frame-pointer-enabled branch leaves the flag unclaimed when frame pointers are omitted, emitting false-positive -Wunused-command-line-argument warnings.

In runImpl (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/InstSimplifyPass.cpp), failing to set Changed = true when collecting trivially dead instructions causes InstSimplifyPass to report no modifications to the pass manager despite removing dead calls and instructions.

In Writer::createSections (lld/COFF/Writer.cpp), stripping name suffixes from all MinGW COMDAT sections collapses .tls$$<symbol> into .tls, causing comdat thread-local variable chunks to be sorted prior to the .tls start marker chunk.

In MCObjectStreamer::emitCodeAlignment (llvm/lib/MC/MCObjectStreamer.cpp), sections containing linker-relaxable alignment fragments without linker-relaxable instructions are not marked as LinkerRelaxable, causing RISCVAsmBackend::isPCRelFixupResolved to prematurely resolve PC-relative fixups instead of emitting required relocations across alignment boundaries.

In GNUStyle<ELFT>::printHashedSymbol (llvm/tools/llvm-readobj/ELFDumper.cpp), specifying an 18-character field width for 64-bit symbol values in format_hex_no_prefix() violates the maximum 16-hex-digit assertion in FormattedNumber.

In X86AsmBackend (llvm/lib/Target/X86/MCTargetDesc/X86AsmBackend.cpp), shouldForceRelocation defaults to false for expressions with relocation specifiers instead of checking Target.getSpecifier(), causing expressions such as PLT references in CFI jump tables to be resolved as local offsets rather than emitting relocations.

In IsStoredObjCPointer (llvm/lib/Transforms/ObjCARC/ProvenanceAnalysis.cpp), values without use lists such as ConstantData (e.g. null pointers) are assumed to have no stores because their user list is empty, falsely indicating that pointers whose provenance includes constants are never stored and causing unsafe retain/release optimizations.

In Sema::GatherGlobalCodeCompletions (clang/lib/Sema/SemaCodeComplete.cpp), defaulting LoadExternal to false when CodeCompleter is null prevents macros defined in header preambles from being loaded into cached code completion results.

In VPScalarIVStepsRecipe::execute (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlanRecipes.cpp), StartIdx0 is unconditionally converted to IntStepTy using IRBuilder::CreateTrunc, triggering an assertion failure when StartIdx0 has a narrower integer type than IntStepTy and requires sign extension rather than truncation.

In parseDebugTypes (lld/COFF/Driver.cpp), passing false to StringRef::split's MaxSplit parameter and querying getSpelling() instead of getValue() prevents comma-separated /debugtype: options from splitting and triggers spurious unknown option warnings.

In LoopPredication::parseLoopLatchICmp (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/LoopPredication.cpp), invoking BranchInst::getCondition() on the loop latch terminator prior to verifying that the branch is conditional causes an assertion crash on unconditional latches.

In Sema::CheckEquivalentExceptionSpec (clang/lib/Sema/SemaExceptionSpec.cpp), omitting the EST_NoThrow case in the exception specification formatting switch causes an assertion crash via llvm_unreachable() when diagnosing redeclarations missing __attribute__((nothrow)).

In Sema::AddArgumentDependentLookupCandidates (clang/lib/Sema/SemaOverload.cpp), transposing the AllowExplicit and AllowExplicitConversions arguments when invoking AddOverloadCandidate incorrectly rejects explicit candidates during argument-dependent lookup.

In Parser::isTemplateArgumentList (clang/lib/Parse/ParseTentative.cpp), tentatively classifying any < token sequence containing a comma followed by a type declaration specifier as a template-id causes valid less-than comparison expressions to be misparsed.

In getStorageClass (clang/lib/AST/Decl.cpp), querying only the canonical declaration storage class prevents MSVC compatibility mode from recognizing subsequent static redeclarations of extern variables and functions, incorrectly assigning them external linkage.

In undefine (lld/wasm/LTO.cpp), replacing DefinedFunction with UndefinedFunction during WebAssembly LTO defaults isCalledDirectly to true even for functions that are only address-taken, causing the linker to populate incomplete signatures from indirect references (such as vtables) and falsely report signature mismatch errors against true definitions.

In CallLowering::handleAssignments (llvm/lib/CodeGen/GlobalISel/CallLowering.cpp), attempting to construct an EVT from CurVT without checking CurVT.isValid() triggers an assertion failure when lowering calls with oversized types such as i256.

In arm::getARMTargetFeatures (clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Arch/ARM.cpp), resolving default CPU and FPU features is skipped whenever ForAS is set, preventing required target feature flags such as +vfp4 or +neon from being passed to cc1as for targets like armv7s-apple-darwin or armv7-windows and causing valid floating-point/SIMD assembly instructions to fail to compile.

In InstCombiner::SimplifyDemandedVectorElts (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineSimplifyDemanded.cpp), pruning pointer operand lanes for masked_load and masked_gather based on result vector element demands replaces active pointer operands with undef, leading to runtime segmentation faults.

In MemoryDepChecker::couldPreventStoreLoadForward (llvm/lib/Analysis/LoopAccessAnalysis.cpp), MaxVF is computed by dividing MaxVFWithoutSLForwardIssuesPowerOf2 by CommonStride without rounding down to a power of two, violating the power-of-two vectorization factor invariant when CommonStride is not a power of two and triggering downstream crashes in LoopVectorize.

In llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAGBuilder.h, storing dangling debug information in an unordered pointer-keyed DenseMap causes resolveOrClearDbgInfo to iterate in non-deterministic address order, producing variable object file output.

In ExprEngine::VisitInitListExpr (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Core/ExprEngineC.cpp), omitting a check for !IE->isTransparent() creates ill-formed CompoundVal structures when modeling transparent initializer lists, causing static analyzer crashes during symbolic execution of C++17 aggregate initializers.

In llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86InstrSSE.td, specifying a register operand VR128 instead of an address operand addr for the loaded memory operand in VBLENDPSrmi patterns causes instruction selection failures on folded vector blend instructions.

In llvm/include/llvm-c/DebugInfo.h, LLVMDISubrangeTypeMetadataKind was inserted into the middle of the LLVMMetadataKind enum definition rather than appended to the end, altering the integer values of subsequent enum constants and breaking binary compatibility for C API consumers and OCaml bindings.

In Sema::ProcessDeclAttributeList (clang/lib/Sema/SemaDeclAttr.cpp), validating objc_designated_initializer before objc_method_family(init) is processed causes the compiler to reject methods that are dynamically assigned to the init family.

In matchTruncateWithPACK (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), the presence of the no-signed-wrap flag on an ISD::TRUNCATE node unconditionally selects X86ISD::PACKSS without verifying that the destination scalar type is not i32, attempting to emit non-existent 64-bit to 32-bit PACKSS instructions and crashing instruction selection.

In ELFState<ELFT>::writeSectionContent (llvm/tools/yaml2obj/yaml2elf.cpp), writing .dynamic section entries using 64-bit ELFT::Xword instead of target-width ELFT::Addr doubles entry sizes and corrupts dynamic sections on 32-bit ELF targets.

In Sema::CheckParameter (clang/lib/Sema/SemaDecl.cpp), calling DelayedDiagnostics.add unconditionally without checking shouldDelayDiagnostics() crashes on an assertion when diagnosing unowned object array parameters in contexts lacking an active diagnostic pool.

In AArch64FrameLowering::emitPrologue (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64FrameLowering.cpp), copying AArch64::X1 into the frame pointer in asynchronous SEH funclet prologues without adding X1 as a live-in to the entry basic block triggers MachineVerifier assertion failures.

In FixedCompilationDatabase::FixedCompilationDatabase and stripPositionalArgs (clang/lib/Tooling/CompilationDatabase.cpp), using a dummy "clang-tool" executable name as argv[0] prevents the Clang driver from inferring the compiler install directory to locate libc++ headers on macOS.

In RISCVABIInfo::coerceVLSVector (clang/lib/CodeGen/Targets/RISCV.cpp), calling getNaturalAlignIndirect with ByVal=false passes false to the newly inserted AddrSpace parameter while ByVal defaults to true, causing large VLS vector arguments to be passed as byval pointers in address space 0 instead of standard indirect pointers in the alloca address space.

In CheckMultiVersionAdditionalDecl (clang/lib/Sema/SemaDecl.cpp), passing false for CausesMV when validating forward-declared cpu_dispatch functions bypasses checks that ensure a function is not called prior to becoming multiversioned.

In ELFDumper<ELFT>::getDynamicSymbolVersion (llvm/tools/llvm-readobj/ELFDumper.cpp), failing to filter out default global and local symbol version indices causes llvm-readobj and llvm-readelf to append an erroneous trailing @ character to unversioned dynamic symbol names.

In AArch64InstructionSelector::selectMergeValues (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64InstructionSelector.cpp), assigning a newly created virtual register as the definition of BFMXri while erasing the original G_MERGE_VALUES instruction leaves the original merge destination register without a definition.

In isSpecialMixedSignMultiply (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGBuiltin.cpp), checking that operand bit-widths are equal (Op1Info.Width == Op2Info.Width) prevents mixed-width mixed-sign arguments to __builtin_mul_overflow from utilizing specialized overflow lowering. Consequently, code generation falls back to generic checked multiplication intrinsics requiring runtime library support (such as __muloti4), causing link failures or compiler crashes on targets lacking 65-bit or 128-bit overflow multiplication support.

In CodeCompletionDeclConsumer::FoundDecl (clang/lib/Sema/SemaCodeComplete.cpp), unqualified lookup within an inner class retains the inner class as the NamingClass when resolving members of outer classes. This mismatch violates the precondition in Sema::IsSimplyAccessible that the naming class must derive from the declaration context, triggering an assertion failure or crash during code completion.

In Instruction::update (llvm/tools/llvm-mca/lib/Instruction.cpp), partial register write states query the latency cycles of a dependent full register write through a raw pointer. Because r346487 enabled EntryStage to garbage collect retired instructions, the memory for the full write can be deallocated before dependent partial writes finish execution, resulting in a use-after-free memory read.

In CGDebugInfo::EmitLocation (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGDebugInfo.cpp), LexicalBlockStack.back() is accessed unconditionally without verifying whether the stack is empty. When emitting sanitizer checks in function epilogues where lexical blocks have already been popped, this causes an out-of-bounds vector access and use-after-free crash.

In LoopVectorizationCostModel::computeMaxVF (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp), vectorization under size optimization (-Os/-Oz) does not bail out when loops require runtime SCEV overflow or stride-one checks. Because tail-folding by masking cannot coexist with runtime check versioning, this triggers an assertion failure in InnerLoopVectorizer::emitSCEVChecks.

In lldb/source/Plugins/Process/Utility/RegisterFlagsDetector_arm64.cpp, HWCAP_GCS is defined as (1UL << 32), which undergoes integer shift overflow on 32-bit architectures and 64-bit Windows (LLP64) where unsigned long is 32 bits, evaluating to zero and preventing LLDB from detecting GCS register fields.

In getBlockCaptureStr (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGBlocks.cpp), allocating a new temporary ItaniumMangleContext for each captured field resets the lambda discriminator counter. Consequently, distinct lambdas defined within the same context receive identical mangled type strings, causing blocks with different lambda captures to incorrectly share copy and destroy helper functions.

In Sema::EnterExpressionEvaluationContext (clang/include/clang/Sema/Sema.h), enclosing immediate function contexts are unconditionally inherited into non-lambda member functions, causing calls to immediate functions within default member initializers to be erroneously treated as deferred rather than evaluated and producing false compile errors.

In PPCTargetLowering::LowerFormalArguments_32SVR4 and LowerCall_32SVR4 (llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCISelLowering.cpp), boolean (i1) stack arguments under the crbits feature are not extended to 32 bits and are placed at the beginning rather than right-justified in 4-byte stack slots. This misalignment violates the PPC32 SVR4 ABI convention, corrupting stack-passed boolean arguments between callers and callees.

In HexagonTargetLowering::HexagonTargetLowering (llvm/lib/Target/Hexagon/HexagonISelLowering.cpp), custom libcall names such as __hexagon_floattidf and __hexagon_fixsfti are registered for 128-bit integer and floating-point conversions despite not being implemented in libclang_rt.builtins-hexagon.a, causing undefined reference link errors instead of using standard compiler-rt builtins.

In polly/lib/CodeGen/PerfMonitor.cpp, PerfMonitor generates calls to the @llvm.x86.rdtscp intrinsic passing a memory pointer and expecting an i64 return value. Because r341698 changed the intrinsic signature to nullary returning { i64, i32 }, the emitted call instructions produce malformed LLVM IR that triggers an IR verification failure.

In SelectionDAGBuilder::CopyValueToVirtualRegister (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAGBuilder.cpp), cross-block virtual register copies query getABIRegCopyCC(V) to split values according to target call ABI rules. When a vector call return value is split into multiple registers for the call ABI but copied as an unsplit vector across basic blocks, mismatched copy sizes lead to MachineVerifier failures or backend crashes.

In DarwinClang::AddLinkRuntimeLib (clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Darwin.cpp), getOSLibraryNameSuffix() appends a simulator suffix (e.g., 'iossim') when constructing the compiler-rt builtins library filename. Because builtins for iOS, tvOS, and watchOS simulators are distributed within the non-simulator archive (libclang_rt.ios.a), the driver attempts to link a nonexistent library, failing the link step.

In ProcessElfCore::FindBuidIdInCoreMemory (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/elf-core/ProcessElfCore.cpp), reading the PT_NOTE segment calculates the virtual address by adding the ELF header load address to program_header.p_vaddr without subtracting the base virtual address of the first PT_LOAD segment, resulting in an incorrect memory address and failing to locate the GNU build ID for non-zero base executables.

In GenerateModuleInterfaceAction::CreateASTConsumer (clang/lib/Frontend/FrontendActions.cpp), CXX20ModulesGenerator and ReducedBMIGenerator are constructed with AllowASTWithErrors hardcoded to false, ignoring FrontendOpts.AllowPCMWithCompilerErrors and preventing the generation of module interfaces when parsing errors are encountered.

In RISC-V TableGen instruction selection patterns, defining OperandTransform on CSImm12MulBy4 and CSImm12MulBy8 transforms immediate operands twice when matching XTheadba patterns that retain explicit arithmetic shifts, generating invalid immediate values.
In llvm-jitlink, concurrent linking allows test assertion checks to execute before transitively referenced object files finish linking, causing race condition assertion failures during testing.

In VPReductionPHIRecipe::execute (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlanRecipes.cpp), FindLastIV reduction PHI execution retrieves the reduction start value from the underlying instruction rather than the recipe operand, causing epilogue vectorization loops to resume with the initial sentinel value instead of the accumulated reduction value.

In SimpleSValBuilder::simplifySVal (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Core/SimpleSValBuilder.cpp), attempting to simplify binary SymSymExpr expressions containing mixed Loc and NonLoc operands loses pointer-to-integer cast metadata. When one operand resolves to a concrete value, re-evaluating the mixed expression without the original LocAsInteger context triggers an assertion failure or crash.

In BFEPattern (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/AMDGPUInstructions.td), bitfield extract selection patterns pass a zero constant immediate directly to UBFE and SBFE instructions. Because R600 hardware BFE instructions do not support immediate operands and require a register input via a MOV instruction, instruction selection fails or produces invalid instructions.

In llvm/lib/Target/Mips/MipsInstrFPU.td, the MipsTruncIntFP pattern for TRUNC_W_D64 is guarded by the overly restrictive ISA_MIPS3 predicate instead of ISA_MIPS2. Consequently, MIPS32 targets with 64-bit floating-point registers fail to match the hardware truncation instruction during instruction selection.

In JITLink MachO arm64e target execution, static initializer function pointers in the __mod_init_func section are emitted as raw unsigned pointers without PAC authentication signatures, causing pointer authentication failures and runtime crashes when called.

In OutgoingArgHandler::assignValueToAddress (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64CallLowering.cpp), the store size is expanded for any-extended arguments without inserting an explicit G_ANYEXT for the source virtual register. The resulting G_STORE instruction contains mismatched register and memory operand sizes, which cannot be selected and forces GlobalISel to abort and fall back to SelectionDAG.

In lld/ELF/Config.h, value-initializing the OutSections structure causes implicit instantiation of std::unique_ptr<OutputSection>::~unique_ptr() where OutputSection is an incomplete type, causing compilation failures with Clang < 16 and libstdc++.

In TargetLoweringObjectFileCOFF::getSectionForConstant (llvm/lib/CodeGen/TargetLoweringObjectFileImpl.cpp), mergeable constants are unconditionally emitted into associative COMDAT sections for all COFF targets. Because GNU binutils tooling for MinGW does not support the null storage class symbols generated for associative COMDATs, the resulting object files are rejected by the linker.

In clang/include/clang/Serialization/ASTBitCodes.h, introducing AmdgpuNamedBarrier into predefined type IDs causes the count of predefined types to exceed NUM_PREDEF_TYPE_IDS, triggering a static assertion failure during AST serialization compilation.

In LazyOffsetPtr::getAddressOfPointer (clang/include/clang/AST/ExternalASTSource.h), reinterpreting a uint64_t member as a pointer via reinterpret_cast violates the C++ object model and corrupts discriminator bits on big-endian and 32-bit platforms.

In lldb/source/Plugins/Process/FreeBSD/NativeRegisterContextFreeBSD_arm64.cpp, converting Status into a value type omitted several call sites, causing compilation failures on FreeBSD/aarch64 due to invalid Status constructor invocations.

In OpAsmParser::parseInteger (mlir/include/mlir/IR/OpImplementation.h), the validation APInt constructor unconditionally passes isSigned=true, causing unsigned integer values with the high bit set to be sign-extended and rejected with an integer value too large error.

In shouldAddProvideSym (lld/ELF/LinkerScript.cpp), the function returns false while a symbol is defined but returns true after the symbol is demoted to Undefined during garbage collection, causing evaluation of unreferenced PROVIDE expressions and false symbol not found errors.

In OmpStructureChecker::CheckSymbolNames (flang/lib/Semantics/check-omp-structure.cpp), variables having the Fortran POINTER attribute are rejected as invalid variable list items in OpenMP data-sharing clauses, preventing compilation of valid OpenMP Fortran programs.

In Driver::GetNamedOutputPath (clang/lib/Driver/Driver.cpp), checking JA.getType() == types::TY_ModuleFile causes module file precompilation jobs to default to stdout ('-') as their output path. Consequently, precompiling C++ module files without an explicit -o flag dumps binary .pcm contents to the terminal instead of writing to a .pcm file.
In compiler-rt/lib/lsan/lsan_common.cpp, the Fuchsia platform stub for ReportUnsuspendedThreads returns void instead of bool, causing compilation failures when building LeakSanitizer for Fuchsia.

In matchSelectPattern (llvm/lib/Analysis/ValueTracking.cpp), recognizing absolute value select patterns strictly requires the true/false values to be identical to the compared operand. When the selected values are sign extensions of the compared operand, the pattern fails to match, causing isKnownNonNegative to return false and preventing LoopIdiomRecognize from converting loops into ctlz intrinsics.

In isAcceptableTemplateName and isTemplateName (clang/lib/Sema/SemaTemplate.cpp), unresolved using declarations following the template keyword are rejected as non-template names or passed to cast<TemplateDecl>. This premature rejection triggers an assertion failure or false compilation error when accessing dependent template members introduced by using declarations prior to template instantiation.

In HostInfoMacOSX::ComputeClangDirectory (lldb/source/Host/macosx/HostInfoMacOSX.mm), verifying framework paths checks only the trailing path component for 'LLDB.framework'. In standard macOS framework bundles where the shared library resides in subdirectories such as 'Versions/A', this check fails and falls back to Posix-style path resolution, breaking Clang resource directory detection.

In llvm/lib/SandboxIR/Tracker.cpp, CmpSwapOperands::dump() is defined unconditionally outside #ifndef NDEBUG while its callee dump(raw_ostream &) is defined only in debug builds, causing undefined symbol linker errors in release configurations.

In CodeGenModule::EmitCXXGlobalVarDeclInitFunc (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGDeclCXX.cpp), global initializers for dllexport inline variables are omitted from COMDAT groups under the MSVC C++ ABI, causing exported inline variables to be dynamically initialized multiple times across DSOs.

In tools::ClangAs::ConstructJob (clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Clang.cpp), implementing clang-cl /Z7 as an alias of -g causes ClangAs to emit DWARF debug sections when assembling assembly files, creating hybrid binaries that prevent LLDB from locating standalone PDB debug files.

In VPWidenCallRecipe::computeCost (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlanRecipes.cpp), calling TTI.getIntrinsicInstrCost omits the underlying IntrinsicInst pointer, causing target cost models that inspect call operands to compute inaccurate vectorization costs.

In RegionStoreManager::getBindingForField (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Core/RegionStore.cpp), InitList->getInit() is called with the field index without verifying that the index is within the bounds of the initializer list. When evaluating empty brace initializers ({}), this causes an out-of-bounds array access and crash in InitListExpr::getInit.

In InstCombinerImpl::transformZExtICmp (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineCasts.cpp), the zero-extended bit test fold for (zext (icmp ne (and X, (1 << ShAmt)), 0)) is restricted to identical bit widths, causing bit test expressions with differing operand and result widths to miss simplification.

In InferAddressSpacesImpl::updateAddressSpace (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/InferAddressSpaces.cpp), getPredicatedAddrSpace unconditionally casts user values via cast<Instruction>, causing an assertion failure and crash when encountering non-instruction users such as constant expressions.

In MicrosoftCXXNameMangler::mangleType (clang/lib/AST/MicrosoftMangle.cpp), the case label for BuiltinType::Char8 is placed above BuiltinType::Float16 due to an incorrect merge. Consequently, char8_t falls through and is incorrectly mangled as struct __clang::_Float16 under the Microsoft C++ ABI instead of being diagnosed as unsupported.

In lld/MachO/Driver.cpp, referencing unqualified size_t without inclusion of <cstddef> causes compilation failures on platforms such as ARM Ubuntu where size_t is not declared in the global namespace.

In CodeGenFunction::EmitDelegateCallArg (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGCall.cpp), delegating a function call with callee-destructed struct parameters (such as structs containing ARC __weak references) fails to deactivate cleanups in the enclosing function. Because both the caller and the delegated callee run cleanups on the same parameter, the struct is destructed twice at runtime.

In subvector_zero_lowering (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86InstrVecCompiler.td), instruction selection patterns for zero-extended vector loads match unaligned load predicates to aligned vector instructions (such as VMOVAPS and VMOVDQA). At runtime, loading unaligned memory with aligned instructions raises a hardware general protection fault (#GP).

In LoopVectorizationPlanner::precomputeCosts (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp), live-out instructions are penalized with extract costs even when a scalar epilogue is required, failing to reflect that external users consume values produced by the scalar epilogue.

In CodeGenFunction::EmitCountedByField (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGExpr.cpp), empty struct FieldDecl members are not ignored when computing field indices, causing assertion failures or crashes because empty fields are omitted from CGRecordLayout.

In PPCLinuxAsmPrinter::emitInstruction (llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCAsmPrinter.cpp), the emission logic for XRay exit sled pseudo-instructions terminates cases with break instead of return, causing execution to fall through and crash when attempting to lower pseudo-instructions as real machine instructions.

In removeUnusedSyntheticSections (lld/ELF/Writer.cpp), calling SS->empty() before checking whether the parent output section pointer OS is null invokes ARMExidxSentinelSection::empty(). When .ARM.exidx sections are discarded by a linker script, getParent() returns null, causing an unconditional null pointer dereference and crash in lld.

In ARMBaseInstrInfo::optimizeCompareInstr (llvm/lib/Target/ARM/ARMBaseInstrInfo.cpp), searching backward for flag-setting instructions prematurely returns false when reaching the beginning of a basic block (I == B) and fails to guard block-boundary iterators. This premature termination halts candidate inspection, preventing redundant comparison instructions from being eliminated in favor of existing flag-setting subtract instructions.

In LoopVectorizationPlanner::willGenerateVectors (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp), ephemeral recipes are not recognized in VPlan, causing the vectorizer to emit vector loops when the only vectorized instructions are ephemeral values that produce no code.

In TargetPassConfig::addCoreISelPasses (llvm/lib/CodeGen/TargetPassConfig.cpp), command-line option evaluation fails to respect -global-isel=false when -fast-isel=0 is also specified. Because the explicit command-line flag does not override TM->Options.EnableGlobalISel, GlobalISel runs unexpectedly instead of SelectionDAG.

In CodeGenFunction::EmitPointerWithAlignment (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGExpr.cpp), handling derived-to-base casts propagates the derived class TBAA access information directly to base class member accesses. Because the generated access path does not reflect the base class type, backend IR verification fails with a fatal error ('Broken function found (Did not see access type in access path!)').

In Writer<ELFT>::run (lld/ELF/Writer.cpp), compressing debug sections via maybeCompress before invoking assignAddresses resolves relocations against symbols in non-debug sections before final addresses are computed. This premature compression patches debug relocations with stale addresses and causes race conditions when compressed debug sections reference each other.

In adjustCallLocations (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Core/BugReporter.cpp), an assertion enforces that every non-call path diagnostic piece has a valid source location. Because body-farmed functions synthesize diagnostic pieces with invalid locations that are only pruned in a subsequent cleanup pass, this assertion fails and crashes the compiler when reporting defects in synthesized functions such as std::call_once.

In resolveReloc (lld/ELF/MarkLive.cpp), defined symbol sections are unconditionally cast to InputSectionBase during garbage collection liveness analysis. When a relocation references a linker-defined reserved symbol (such as _end) that resides in an OutputSection rather than an InputSection, the cast fails an assertion and crashes lld.

In AVRAsmBackend::adjustFixupValue (llvm/lib/Target/AVR/MCTargetDesc/AVRAsmBackend.cpp) and AVRMCExpr::getFixupKind, missing switch cases for the gs() modifier and fixup kinds fixup_lo8_ldi_gs, fixup_hi8_ldi_gs, fixup_16_pm, and FK_Data_1 cause the AVR assembler to hit an unreachable error when evaluating relocations for flash-memory data symbols.

In SimplifyIndvar::makeIVComparisonInvariant (llvm/lib/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyIndVar.cpp), calling PN->getIncomingValueForBlock(BB) with the loop predecessor unconditionally triggers an assertion failure when optimizing comparisons whose induction variable PHI node is located outside the loop header (such as in the latch block).

In BPFRegisterInfo::eliminateFrameIndex (llvm/lib/Target/BPF/BPFRegisterInfo.cpp), the compiler unconditionally scans all instructions in basic blocks to locate debug information for stack overflow diagnostics, causing massive compile-time slowdowns even without -g and when stack size limits are not exceeded.

In SplitOp::apply (mlir/lib/Dialect/Linalg/TransformOps/LinalgTransformOps.cpp), target->getLoc() is evaluated as a function argument after linalg::splitOp has already erased target, causing an unconditional access-after-free on deleted operation pointers.

In EHPersonality::get (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGException.cpp), checking L.SEHExceptions for Windows MSVC environments causes Clang to select the MinGW personality function (__gxx_personality_seh0) instead of Microsoft's __CxxFrameHandler3 for C++ exception handling on MSVC targets.

In MachineLICMBase::IsClobberedByRegMask (llvm/lib/CodeGen/MachineLICM.cpp), applying register masks with RegUnits causes instructions to be hoisted across calls when target register units are incompletely defined, resulting in clobbered register values on AArch64.

In CodeGenPrepare::simplifyOffsetableRelocate (llvm/lib/CodeGen/CodeGenPrepare.cpp), statepoint relocate instructions are tracked in a DenseMap, causing the order of IR transformations to depend non-deterministically on hash table bucket iteration order.

In applyBitsNotInRegMaskToRegUnitsMask (llvm/lib/CodeGen/MachineLICM.cpp), register units of all registers absent from a call register mask are marked as clobbered without checking if those units belong to preserved registers, erroneously clobbering preserved register units and preventing valid loop-invariant instruction hoisting across calls.

In FunctionStackPoisoner::visitAllocaInst (llvm/lib/Transforms/Instrumentation/AddressSanitizer.cpp), allocas allocating structures containing scalable vector types are not filtered out alongside scalar scalable vectors, causing the compiler to crash during stack frame layout and poisoning because scalable vector sizes cannot be determined statically.

In SelectionDAGISel::initializeAnalysisResults (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAGISel.cpp), initializing TTI is guarded by #ifndef NDEBUG rather than checking LLVM_ENABLE_ABI_BREAKING_CHECKS, causing LLVM compilation to fail with an undeclared identifier error in assertion builds where ABI breaking checks are disabled.

In ASTContext::isSameEntity (clang/lib/AST/ASTContext.cpp), target declarations of UsingShadowDecl are compared using pointer equality rather than calling declaresSameEntity, causing equivalent using declarations imported from different C++ modules to fail merging and trigger false-positive One Definition Rule violation diagnostics.

In Parser::ParseStatementOrDeclarationAfterAttributes (clang/lib/Parse/ParseStmt.cpp), statement parsing in C permits declarations in substatement contexts without verifying that the enclosing context allows them, erroneously accepting invalid syntax such as a declaration immediately following an if statement or loop condition.

In SILoadStoreOptimizer::findMatchingInst (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SILoadStoreOptimizer.cpp), checking memory reordering legality against only the anchor instruction without verifying dependencies against instructions already queued to move causes conflicting memory operations to be illegally reordered during load/store merging.

In IsOverloadOrOverrideImpl (clang/lib/Sema/SemaOverload.cpp), a condition checking member function staticness checks !OldMethod->isStatic() twice instead of checking !NewMethod->isStatic(), causing the compiler to bypass overload checking and permit invalid overloading between static and non-static member functions with identical parameter types.

In ConvertConstructorToDeductionGuideTransform::transformConstructor (clang/lib/Sema/SemaTemplate.cpp), transforming constructor parameters for deduction guides in nested class templates processes inner template parameters before outer parameters, assigning incorrect depth indices to invented parameters and causing template argument deduction to fail.

In computeFunctionSummary (llvm/lib/Analysis/ModuleSummaryAnalysis.cpp), an over-restrictive assertion assumes that any call that is not a direct function call must be an indirect call, triggering an assertion failure when ThinLTO processes calls targeted through constant expressions (such as constant select expressions).

In LocalVisitor::TraverseDecl (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Checkers/WebKit/UncountedCallArgsChecker.cpp), passing Decl *D directly to isa<ClassTemplateDecl> without checking for a null pointer causes a null pointer dereference and crash when traversing ASTs with null declarations such as template template parameters.

In RISCVInsertVSETVLI::doPRE (llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVInsertVSETVLI.cpp), partial redundancy elimination fails to check if AvailableInfo has an ignored AVL (hasAVLIgnored()), causing the pass to attempt inserting a vsetvli instruction without a valid AVL operand and crashing the compiler.

In TypeSystemClang.cpp (lldb/source/Plugins/TypeSystem/Clang/TypeSystemClang.cpp), switch statements reference the obsolete clang::BuiltinType::Kind::OMPArraySection identifier after it was renamed to ArraySection, causing LLDB compilation to fail.

In SymbolTable::applySymbolWrap (lld/ELF/SymbolTable.cpp), failing to clear IsUsedInRegularObj on the wrap symbol when no __real_ symbol is referenced causes LLD to emit duplicate symbol definitions for __wrap_ symbols into the output ELF symbol table.

In ContinuationIndenter::addTokenOnCurrentLine (clang/lib/Format/ContinuationIndenter.cpp), parameter wrapping logic does not check whether the preceding token is an immediately adjacent block comment with no trailing whitespace, incorrectly breaking lines after inline parameter naming comments.

In OpOperandAdaptorEmitter::OpOperandAdaptorEmitter (mlir/tools/mlir-tblgen/OpDefinitionsGen.cpp), attribute getter methods in adaptor classes are unconditionally emitted with Method::Properties::Inline whenever there is no default value, generating conflicting out-of-line method definitions and breaking compilation for dialects that do not use properties.

In CheckExtVectorComponent (clang/lib/Sema/SemaExprMember.cpp), OpenCL vector swizzle length restrictions were applied unconditionally, causing Clang to reject valid non-OpenCL extended vector swizzles of non-standard lengths in C and C++ programs.

In GetTemplateParameterList (clang/lib/Sema/SemaTemplate.cpp), fetching template parameters from TD->getMostRecentDecl() without skipping friend template declarations retrieves template parameters belonging to an enclosing scope with mismatched template depths, causing constraint substitution to fail during class template argument deduction.

In OptionGroupVariable (lldb/source/Interpreter/OptionGroupVariable.cpp), hardcoded option offset constants assume three frame-specific options instead of four, causing target variable to erroneously advertise the frame-only --show-globals option and map command line arguments to incorrect option handlers.

In llvm/lib/Target/BPF/BPFInstrInfo.td, the Select_Ri pseudo-instruction pattern matches arbitrary 64-bit immediates instead of restricting to 32-bit signed immediates, causing 64-bit comparison constants to be silently truncated when lowered to 32-bit immediate BPF jump instructions.

In CodeGenFunction::StartFunction (clang/lib/CodeGen/CodeGenFunction.cpp), UBSan function signature prologue data was emitted for non-static member functions that are never called through standard function pointers, producing PC-relative cross-section relocations on Linux that the assembler cannot represent.
In openmp/libomptarget/plugins-nextgen/cuda/src/rtl.cpp, invoking the removed getELFObjectFile member function on Handler causes compilation of the OpenMP CUDA nextgen plugin to fail.

In LiveDebugVariables.cpp, maintaining separate UserValue objects for direct and indirect DBG_VALUE instructions describing the same variable causes identical location intervals separated by an interval of opposite directness to be incorrectly coalesced.

In haveEfficientBuildVectorPattern (llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCISelLowering.cpp), v4f32 vector splats were allowed for all VSX-capable targets without verifying POWER8 vector support, resulting in the generation of the xscvdpspn instruction which is unsupported and crashes on POWER7 hardware.

In TransferVisitor::VisitInitListExpr (clang/lib/Analysis/FlowSensitive/Transfer.cpp), initializer list evaluation does not handle union types before assuming structure or class types, causing clang's dataflow analysis framework to crash when analyzing InitListExpr initializers for unions.

In main and dumpConfig (clang/tools/clang-format/ClangFormat.cpp), executing clang-format -dump-config with no input files implicitly appends "-" to FileNames and attempts to read from STDIN to detect the language, causing the tool to hang indefinitely waiting for user input.

In X86TargetLowering::LowerGlobalTLSAddress (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), OpFlag and WrapperKind are chosen inconsistently when lowering Darwin TLS addresses under non-RIP-relative PIC models, triggering assertion failures during instruction selection.

In SelectPropertyForSynthesisFromProtocols (clang/lib/Sema/SemaObjCProperty.cpp), comparing full property attributes via getPropertyAttributes() instead of getPropertyAttributesAsWritten() treats the implicit strong attribute added under ARC as a conflicting attribute, falsely reporting an ambiguity error when synthesizing a readonly property redeclared as readwrite.

In Darwin::AddDeploymentTarget (clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Darwin.cpp), refactoring of target warning checks omitted clamping the inferred deployment target to 10.99.99 for 32-bit architectures, erroneously producing an iOS 11+ deployment target and issuing a spurious warning when building against newer SDKs via -isysroot.

In DebugValueUser::handleChangedValue (llvm/lib/IR/Metadata.cpp), std::distance is invoked with a std::array iterator and a raw Metadata** pointer, causing compilation to fail on standard library implementations where container iterators are not raw pointers.

In IsOverloadOrOverrideImpl (clang/lib/Sema/SemaOverload.cpp), template parameter equivalence is evaluated before verifying that the declaration contexts of candidate function templates match, violating an internal assertion in TemplateParameterList::shouldIncludeConstraintsForEquivalence and crashing the compiler.

In TokenAnnotator::isStartOfName (clang/lib/Format/TokenAnnotator.cpp), identifier checks designed to prevent breaking inside #pragma directives are applied globally, causing attribute macros to be misannotated and disrupting declaration formatting.

In UnwrappedLineParser::parseStructuralElement (clang/lib/Format/UnwrappedLineParser.cpp), colon detection for goto labels does not exclude JavaScript or TypeScript, causing object and type field declarations with colons to be classified as goto labels and formatted with unwanted line breaks.

In genBodyOfTargetOp (flang/lib/Lower/OpenMP.cpp), lambda closures capture structured bindings produced by llvm::enumerate by reference, violating C++17 language rules and causing Flang compilation to fail on conforming C++17 compilers.

In performTBISimplification (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64ISelLowering.cpp), passing DCI.isBeforeLegalize() directly to the AfterLegalize parameter of TargetLoweringOpt inverts the legalization status flag, falsely informing demanded bits analysis that legalization has already occurred.

In X86AsmParser::CreateMemForMSInlineAsm (llvm/lib/Target/X86/AsmParser/X86AsmParser.cpp), function pointer variables in MS-style inline assembly calls and jumps are not assigned a base register, causing them to be classified as absolute memory operands and miscompiled into direct function calls (${:P}) instead of indirect calls.

In BlockGenerator::generateConditionalExecution (polly/lib/CodeGen/BlockGenerators.cpp), checking domain subset relations without intersecting the SCoP parameter context causes full writes that only appear partial outside the context to be wrongly treated as partial writes, introducing invalid conditional execution guards that crash the compiler.
