In RegisterFlagsLinux_arm64.cpp (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/Utility/RegisterFlagsLinux_arm64.cpp), HWCAP2_EBF16 is defined by shifting a 32-bit 1UL literal left by 32 bits, causing a shift-count-overflow compile error and undefined behavior when building LLDB on 32-bit host platforms.

In State::addInfoForInductions (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/ConstraintElimination.cpp), the pass fails to verify that an induction recurrence belongs to the current loop (AR->getLoop() != L), causing constraint facts derived from outer or adjacent loops to be incorrectly applied to the current loop and leading to miscompilations or crashes.

In DAGTypeLegalizer::WidenVectorResult (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/LegalizeVectorTypes.cpp), ISD::LRINT and ISD::LLRINT vector results are widened using WidenVecRes_Unary, erroneously assuming identical source and result element types and causing SelectionDAG crashes or incorrect code generation.

In ConstantEmitter::tryEmitPrivate (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGExprConstant.cpp), ConstExprEmitter is invoked for destination types that are references, violating emitter assumptions that reference initializers are emitted via the full evaluator and triggering assertion failures or crashes.

In fp_extend.h (compiler-rt/lib/builtins/fp_extend.h), src_rep_t_clz calls __builtin_clz on 16-bit operands without compensating for the 16 leading zero bits introduced by integer promotion, and clz_in_sig_frac applies an incorrect bit shift offset, producing corrupt results when extending denormal floating-point values.

In optimizeLogicalImm (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64ISelLowering.cpp), calling TLO.CombineTo on the immediate operand instead of the logical operation node mutates CSE-shared constant nodes across the entire DAG, corrupting operand values in unrelated instructions that share the constant.

In CGDebugInfo::collectFunctionDeclProps (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGDebugInfo.cpp), querying FD->getLexicalDeclContext() instead of FD->getDeclContext() fails to identify the enclosing namespace when a namespaced function is defined out-of-line in the global scope, assigning incorrect scope metadata to the subprogram.

In main (llvm/tools/opt/opt.cpp), codegen::createTargetMachineForTriple is wrapped with ExitOnErr, causing opt to terminate immediately with a fatal error instead of a warning when processing IR with triples for targets not compiled into the tool.

In calculateConstraintSatisfaction (clang/lib/Sema/SemaConcept.cpp), an iterator to Satisfaction.Details.end() is retained across recursive satisfaction checks that can cause Satisfaction.Details to reallocate, causing an invalid iterator dereference and compiler crash during subsequent detail erasure.

In GDBRemoteRegisterContext::AArch64Reconfigure (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/gdb-remote/GDBRemoteRegisterContext.cpp), the cached value of the AArch64 vg register is not invalidated before reading it, causing LLDB to read a stale cached vector granule value and miscalculate SVE register sizes and offsets upon reconfiguration.

In DebugHandlerBase::beginFunction (llvm/lib/CodeGen/AsmPrinter/DebugHandlerBase.cpp), an unconditional assertion requires Asm to be non-null, failing when CodeView intentionally sets Asm to nullptr for translation units without compile units (such as -gcodeview -g0).

In Scop::getNonHoistableCtx (polly/lib/Analysis/ScopInfo.cpp), dereferenceable loads were deemed unconditionally hoistable without verifying whether the accessed memory location was written to within the SCoP, allowing loads with memory write dependencies to be hoisted and load stale data.

In InstCombiner::visitFAdd (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineAddSub.cpp), helper lambda IsValidPromotion called getFltSemantics() directly on FTy without extracting scalar types, triggering an unreachable panic when optimizing vector floating point addition instructions (fadd).
In libcxx/modules/std/ranges.inc, chunk_by_view and views::chunk_by are exported unconditionally without checking for C++23 mode, causing module compilation errors when building the std C++20 module.

In simplifyFCmpInst (llvm/lib/Analysis/InstructionSimplify.cpp), evaluating an fcmp comparison against a literal NaN constant without a context instruction reaches an invalid assertion (!C->isNaN()) instead of folding the comparison based on whether the predicate is unordered.

In DwarfCompileUnit::addComplexAddress (llvm/lib/CodeGen/AsmPrinter/DwarfCompileUnit.cpp), DwarfExpression failed to mark indirect FrameIndex locations as memory locations before processing DIExpression operations, causing DW_OP_deref to be erroneously dropped from the emitted DWARF location expression.

In InitializeInterceptors (compiler-rt/lib/msan/msan_interceptors.cpp), SANITIZER_GLIBC is checked with #ifdef instead of #if, causing glibc-specific __isoc23_* interceptors to be compiled on non-glibc platforms where SANITIZER_GLIBC is defined to 0 and triggering compilation failures.

In AArch64CallLowering::saveVarArgRegisters (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/GISel/AArch64CallLowering.cpp), when lowering Win64 variadic calls with an odd number of saved argument registers, the stack frame does not create padding to align the fixed object to 16 bytes, causing local stack objects to alias and clobber callee-saved registers.

In FakeStack::GC (compiler-rt/lib/asan/asan_fake_stack.cpp), the comparison between real_stack, stack_top, and stack_bottom assumes stack_top has a lower address than stack_bottom, causing the inverted bounds check to misidentify default stack frames and skip fake stack garbage collection.

In __llvm_profile_check_compatibility (compiler-rt/lib/profile/InstrProfilingMerge.c), the profile compatibility check compares the exact byte distance between counter bounds with the source header counter size without accounting for inter-section padding, causing compatible profiles to be falsely rejected.

In SIInstrInfo::isInlineConstant (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SIInstrInfo.cpp), operand types such as OPERAND_INPUT_MODS and OPERAND_IMMEDIATE are not recognized as inline constants, causing instructions with source modifiers to be erroneously treated as having 32-bit literal constants and overestimating instruction code size.

In DeclarationFragmentsBuilder::getFragmentsForSpecialCXXMethod (clang/lib/ExtractAPI/DeclarationFragments.cpp), the destructor branch binds a StringRef to a temporary std::string returned by Method->getNameAsString(), causing a use-after-free and memory corruption when appending the method name to declaration fragments.

In RuntimeDyldImpl::computeTotalAllocSize and RuntimeDyldImpl::emitSection (llvm/lib/ExecutionEngine/RuntimeDyld/RuntimeDyld.cpp), section allocation decisions checked only isRequiredForExecution(Section), ignoring the ProcessAllSections flag and failing to emit non-executable sections such as .debug_str.

In ExprEngine::createTemporaryRegionIfNeeded (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Core/ExprEngine.cpp), creating a temporary object region with subobject adjustments copied only the adjusted subobject value into the sub-region, leaving the remaining fields of the base temporary object uninitialized in the Environment.

In NoteSurrogateCandidate (clang/lib/Sema/SemaOverload.cpp), Cand->FailureKind is checked without verifying !Cand->Viable, reading uninitialized memory when the surrogate candidate is viable and potentially emitting spurious constraint failure notes.

In Sema::DiagnoseUnusedExprResult (clang/lib/Sema/SemaStmt.cpp), functional cast expressions creating temporary objects with non-trivial destructors via list initialization were not unwrapped past enclosing CXXBindTemporaryExpr nodes, causing Clang to incorrectly treat the constructor call as an unused expression result.

In performSETCCCombine (llvm/lib/Target/WebAssembly/WebAssemblyISelLowering.cpp), SIMD reduction combines assume vector operands have at most 16 elements and assert, triggering compiler assertion crashes when lowering vector reductions with wider types like <64 x i1>.

In ObjCMethodDecl::getMethodFamily (clang/lib/AST/DeclObjC.cpp), expanding the OMF_performSelector method family heuristic to include void-returning methods and methods with up to 5 parameters caused ARC to erroneously issue memory leak warnings on delayed selector invocations that do not return retained objects.

In llvm/tools/llvm-exegesis/lib/BenchmarkRunner.cpp, the GLIBC_INITS_RSEQ macro is defined solely based on the glibc version without verifying that RSEQ_SIG is defined, causing compilation failures on architectures like RISC-V and LoongArch whose glibc headers lack RSEQ_SIG.

In llvm/lib/Target/LoongArch/LoongArchInstrInfo.td, the CSR and IOCSR read SDNodes lack the SDNPSideEffect property, allowing the compiler to incorrectly reorder or common subexpression eliminate volatile control and status register reads.

In Module::FindTypes (lldb/source/Core/Module.cpp), type queries without namespace separators passed the raw string (type_name_cstr) rather than the stripped basename (type_basename) to FindTypes_Impl, preventing LLDB from finding types queried with type class prefixes like 'struct TypeName'.

In elf::markLive (lld/ELF/MarkLive.cpp), C-identifier named sections were retained whenever their __start_ / __stop_ symbols were referenced without checking for SHF_LINK_ORDER, erroneously keeping dead metadata sections alive when their associated code sections were discarded.

In AttemptToFoldSymbolOffsetDifference (llvm/lib/MC/MCExpr.cpp), symbol offset difference folding is rejected when evaluating non-variable symbols located within the same fragment being laid out, causing assembler errors expecting an assembly-time absolute expression.

In LayoutOverrideSource::LayoutOverrideSource (clang/lib/Frontend/LayoutOverrideSource.cpp), searching for 'BaseOffsets: [' before 'VBaseOffsets: [' causes lines containing 'VBaseOffsets: [' to falsely match the non-virtual base offset prefix, corrupting the parsed base offsets.

In AArch64InstructionSelector::selectArithImmed (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64InstructionSelector.cpp), calling Def->getOperand(1).getImm() on a G_CONSTANT instruction causes an assertion failure because GlobalISel stores constant operands as ConstantInt (CImm) rather than immediate (Imm) machine operands.

In SelectionDAGISel::SelectCodeCommon (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAGISel.cpp), checking NodeStack[i].hasOneUse() on the SDValue instead of NodeStack[i].getNode()->hasOneUse() ignores uses of other result values of multi-result chain nodes, permitting unsafe node folding into instructions with flag dependencies.

In Writer<ELFT>::addStartEndSymbols (lld/ELF/Writer.cpp), reassigning null section pointers to Out::ElfHeader in PIE/DSO mode causes the array end symbol offset to evaluate to -1 (the end of the ELF header) rather than 0 (the image base), producing non-empty array ranges for missing sections.

In DwarfLinkerForBinary::loadObject (llvm/tools/dsymutil/DwarfLinkerForBinary.cpp), returning an outer-scope unique_ptr into an ErrorOr without an explicit std::move invokes the deleted copy constructor on standards-conforming C++ compilers, causing compilation failure.

In getTargetConstantBitsFromNode (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), constant bit extraction on a ConstantDataSequential unconditionally calls getElementAsAPInt without checking if the elements are floating-point types, triggering an assertion crash when processing broadcasted floating-point constants.

In SubstituteConstraintExpression (clang/lib/Sema/SemaConcept.cpp), substituting template arguments for constraint comparisons lacks an active InstantiatingTemplate code synthesis context, causing an assertion failure when comparing constraints for out-of-line member definitions without an existing parent template context.

In DWARFLinker::DIECloner::cloneExpression (llvm/lib/DWARFLinker/DWARFLinker.cpp), byte order swapping for linked addresses checks only the target endianness (!IsLittleEndian) instead of whether the target and host endianness differ, corrupting DWARF expression addresses when executed on big-endian hosts.

In PPCTargetLowering::PerformDAGCombine (llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCISelLowering.cpp), combining a 64-bit bswap into a narrower store creates a PPCISD::STBRX node with an untruncated i64 value operand, violating instruction operand type constraints and crashing instruction selection.

In TaskGroup::TaskGroup (llvm/lib/Support/Parallel.cpp), threadIndex is accessed unconditionally without checking LLVM_ENABLE_THREADS, causing compilation failures in non-threaded builds where threadIndex is not declared.

In VPlan::~VPlan (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/VPlan.cpp), the disconnected Preheader block allocated for early SCEV expansion is not deleted upon VPlan destruction, causing a memory leak detected by LeakSanitizer.

In CommandObjectMemoryFind::DoExecute (lldb/source/Commands/CommandObjectMemory.cpp), the check for a search string's presence inspects whether the optional is engaged rather than verifying that the string is non-empty, allowing zero-length search strings to bypass validation instead of reporting an error.

In clang/lib/Sema/SemaExpr.cpp, recursive instantiation and transformation of default member and argument initializers in BuildCXXDefaultArgExpr and BuildCXXDefaultInitExpr occur without stack space bounds checking via runWithSufficientStackSpace, causing compiler crashes due to stack exhaustion on deeply nested or recursive initializers.

In getTargetEntryUniqueInfo (mlir/lib/Target/LLVMIR/Dialect/OpenMP/OpenMPToLLVMIRTranslation.cpp), when sys::fs::getUniqueID fails, execution continues into constructing a TargetRegionEntryInfo using uninitialized fields of the UniqueID struct instead of returning failure.

In isConsumerInterestedIn (clang/lib/Serialization/ASTReaderDecl.cpp), calling Ctx.DeclMustBeEmitted(D) before checking D->getImportedOwningModule() triggers premature layout and code generation of record types while dependent forward-declared types are still being deserialized and incomplete.

In llvm/include/llvm/Demangle/ItaniumDemangle.h, invoking std::string_view::substr introduces calls to out-of-range exception throwing routines, causing link failures in libcxxabi when built in environments without C++ exception support.

In AMDGPUAsmParser::ParseDirectiveHSAMetadata (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/AsmParser/AMDGPUAsmParser.cpp), using std::tuple with string literal arrays of differing lengths in a ternary conditional expression causes template argument deduction failures and compiler errors on certain C++ standard library implementations.

In UInt (libc/src/__support/UInt.h), the member array val lacks a default member initializer, causing compilation failures under GCC when default-initializing const UInt instances without a user-provided default constructor.

In swap_value (lldb/source/Core/DumpRegisterValue.cpp), byte swapping unconditionally calls GCC/Clang builtins __builtin_bswap32 and __builtin_bswap64 without portability guards, causing build failures when compiling LLDB with MSVC on Windows.

In Error::SetErrorStringWithVarArg (lldb/source/Utility/Error.cpp), formatting the message into a local buffer without assigning buf.str() to m_string causes the Error object's error string to remain unassigned and empty.

In ARMTargetLowering::duplicateCmp (llvm/lib/Target/ARM/ARMISelLowering.cpp), duplicating ARMISD::CMPFP and CMPFPw0 nodes without copying the newly added QNaN-signaling operand creates malformed SelectionDAG nodes that fail instruction selection.

In unswitchTrivialSwitch (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/SimpleLoopUnswitch.cpp), SCEV invalidation occurs before iterating through the switch case exit indices to compute the outermost loop, causing the pass to miss case exit loops and leave stale SCEV information.

In MCStreamer::EmitLabel (llvm/lib/MC/MCStreamer.cpp), missing symbol redefinition checks (redefineIfPossible) when emitting labels from backend code generation causes duplicate symbol definitions to trigger an assertion failure rather than handling the symbol redefinition cleanly.

In generateCopy (mlir/lib/Dialect/Affine/Utils/LoopUtils.cpp), the output parameter sizeInBytes is not initialized when returning early or when memrefs have unknown element size, causing uninitialized memory reads in affineDataCopyGenerate detected by MemorySanitizer.

In TemplateName::Profile (clang/lib/AST/TemplateName.cpp), folding set profiling uses the underlying TemplateDecl rather than the UsingShadowDecl for UsingTemplate names, prematurely desugaring using-declarations and causing template argument deduction failures with deduction guides.

In DFGImpl::OutputDependencyFile (clang/lib/Frontend/DependencyFile.cpp), refactoring a loop to use range-for syntax iterated over all files including the primary source file, causing Clang to emit a phony target for the input file itself and creating self-referential dependency loops in generated Makefile dependencies.

In SelectionDAG::ReplaceAllUsesWith (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAG.cpp), a lambda expression references MaxDepth without capturing it, causing compilation errors on compilers such as MSVC.

In lldb/source/Plugins/ScriptInterpreter/Lua/ScriptInterpreterLua.cpp, modifying callback signatures in the base script interpreter left the Lua implementation with outdated parameter signatures, causing compilation failures when building LLDB with Lua support.

In DereferenceChecker::checkBind (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Checkers/DereferenceChecker.cpp), binding a reference member initialized with a string literal in a constructor initializer results in a NonLoc value. Passing this NonLoc value to ProgramState::assume violates the assumption that reference bindings are memory locations, triggering an assertion failure or crash in the constraint manager.

In libcxx/src/atomic.cpp, atomic wait operations on FreeBSD invoke _umtx_op indiscriminately on all architectures, but 32-bit FreeBSD targets lack 64-bit wait operations, causing runtime failures on 32-bit systems.

In CodeGenModule::EmitModuleLinkOptions (clang/lib/CodeGen/CodeGenModule.cpp), importing a header belonging to the current module within an implementation translation unit does not exclude the module itself from ImportedModules. This causes Clang to emit autolink linker options for the module being compiled into the LLVM IR metadata, leading to unwanted self-link flags and link failures.

In DAGCombiner::visitABS (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/DAGCombiner.cpp), modifying the absolute difference combine logic globally disabled the (abs (sub nsw x, y)) transformation for non-X86 architectures, preventing AArch64 from selecting SVE saba instructions.

In SSAUpdater::UpdateDebugValue (llvm/lib/Transforms/Utils/SSAUpdater.cpp), invoking GetValueInMiddleOfBlock forces creation of new PHI nodes during debug value updates, causing debug info tracking to inadvertently alter machine code generation.

In ByteCodeExprGen::VisitCompoundAssignOperator (clang/lib/AST/Interp/ByteCodeExprGen.cpp), compound assignment evaluation lacks conversions between the LHS computation type and the result type, causing evaluation miscalculations on big-endian architectures.

In OptTable::findNearest (llvm/lib/Option/OptTable.cpp), evaluating MaximumDistance + 1 triggers an unsigned integer overflow to zero when MaximumDistance equals UINT_MAX, causing nearest-match candidate searches to reject all options.

In TargetMachine::resetTargetOptions (llvm/lib/Target/TargetMachine.cpp), target options such as fast-math attributes are not reset back to DefaultOptions when a function lacks the corresponding attribute. In FakeSectionChunk (lld/COFF/Chunks.h), the SectionChunk member is initialized with the address of a coff_section member declared after it, passing uninitialized memory to SectionChunk and triggering assertion failures during LTO linking.

In processDbgDeclares (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAGISel.cpp), encountering a dbg.declare with empty metadata or an invalid address executes return instead of continue, prematurely terminating processing and discarding all subsequent debug declarations in the function.

In checkForMultipleExportedDefaultConstructors (clang/lib/Sema/SemaDeclCXX.cpp), default arguments of dllexported default constructors under the Microsoft C++ ABI are not marked as ODR-used via CheckCXXDefaultArgExpr. This causes required implicit destructor and constructor definitions referenced by the default arguments to be omitted from code generation, resulting in link errors.
In strndup (libc/src/string/strndup.cpp), memory allocation allocates len bytes instead of len + 1, causing inline_memcpy to copy past the destination buffer when appending the null terminator.

In runBenchmarkConfigurations (llvm/tools/llvm-exegesis/llvm-exegesis.cpp), extracting min repetition logic failed to verify measurement validity, triggering assertion failures when benchmarks encounter missing measurements.

In Function::splice (llvm/lib/IR/Function.cpp), an iterator ordering assertion under EXPENSIVE_CHECKS references an undeclared identifier FromBBEnd, causing compilation failures in expensive-checks builds.

In AAIsDeadFloating::manifest (llvm/lib/Transforms/IPO/AttributorAttributes.cpp), isDeadStore is invoked inside an assert macro, causing the call to be stripped in non-debug Release builds and leaving side-effecting container structures unpopulated.

In UnwrappedLineParser::parseBlock (clang/lib/Format/UnwrappedLineParser.cpp), enabling both RemoveBracesLLVM and MacroBlockBegin leads to misinterpreting macro block boundaries during brace tracking, triggering an assertion failure.

In ModuleDepCollector::serialize (clang/lib/Tooling/DependencyScanning/ModuleDepCollector.cpp), dependency file paths are emitted with mixed path separator conventions across Windows and POSIX, causing test failures from non-deterministic path ordering on Windows.

In SmallPtrSetIterator::operator++(int) (llvm/include/llvm/ADT/SmallPtrSet.h), post-incrementing an iterator when ReverseIterate<bool>::value is enabled attempts to call --*this. Because SmallPtrSetIterator does not implement operator--, any use of post-increment on a SmallPtrSetIterator results in a compilation failure when ABI breaking checks are enabled.

In ARCRegisterInfo::eliminateFrameIndex (llvm/lib/Target/ARC/ARCRegisterInfo.cpp), changing the base class virtual eliminateFrameIndex signature to return bool was not propagated to the ARC target, causing compilation failures in the ARC backend.

In decomposeGEP (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/ConstraintElimination.cpp), determining index size on vector GEPs performs invalid casts to scalar integer types, triggering an assertion failure and crash when analyzing vector GEP pointers.

In TransposeOp::build (mlir/lib/Dialect/Linalg/IR/LinalgOps.cpp), the operation builder omits allocating a region before initializing generic region contents, causing invalid operation state and assertion crashes during transpose construction.

In llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86InstrSSE.td, TableGen definitions for VPMADDUBSW and VPMADDUBSWY are placed outside the isCommutable = 0 block, erroneously marking them as commutable. Because these instructions multiply unsigned bytes by signed bytes, swapping the input operands changes the computation semantics and causes silent miscompilation when the backend commutes them.

In foldSelectShuffleOfSelectShuffle (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineVectorOps.cpp), an assert assumes that folded shuffle masks select elements from both operand vectors, which fails when undef mask elements cause the resulting shuffle to select from only a single vector.

In compiler-rt/lib/lsan/lsan_common.cpp, the Fuchsia platform stub for ProcessThreads was not updated when new parameters were introduced into the function signature, causing compilation failure when building LeakSanitizer for Fuchsia.

In MemSDNode::getRawSubclassData (llvm/include/llvm/CodeGen/SelectionDAGNodes.h), the HasDebugValue bit is included in the subclass data used for FoldingSetNodeID calculation. This prevents SelectionDAG common subexpression elimination from matching memory nodes with debug values to equivalent nodes without debug values, resulting in an infinite loop during type legalization.

In combineOr (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), the constant operand C in (0 - SetCC) | C is truncated to a 32-bit unsigned value, causing 64-bit OR expressions to miscompile into invalid LEA sequences when upper bits of C are non-zero.

In DataAggregator::parseNameBuildIDPair (bolt/lib/Profile/DataAggregator.cpp), checking for a newline consumes the newline character rather than peeking, advancing past line boundaries prematurely and causing line parsing desynchronization.

In DAGTypeLegalizer::ExpandIntRes_MUL (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/LegalizeIntegerTypes.cpp), the fallback expansion for wide integer multiplications misassigns high and low sub-word intermediate terms (TL/TH and LLH/RLH). This produces mathematically incorrect product values at runtime when lowering multiplications for integer types wider than twice the target register width.

In Sema::BuildCXXNew (clang/lib/Sema/SemaExprCXX.cpp), checkArrayElementAlignment is invoked without verifying that the allocated type is an array, falsely rejecting valid C++ new expressions for non-array types.

In ELFLinkGraphBuilder::createNormalizedSymbols (llvm/lib/ExecutionEngine/JITLink/ELFLinkGraphBuilder.h), an overly restrictive check asserts that undefined ELF symbols must have default visibility, rejecting valid ELF objects containing undefined symbols with hidden or protected visibility.

In Sema::CheckTemplateArgument (clang/lib/Sema/SemaTemplate.cpp), the compatibility diagnostic check inspects only top-level AutoType instead of getContainedAutoType(), failing to detect placeholder non-type template parameters nested within compound types.

In SITargetLowering::SITargetLowering (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SIISelLowering.cpp), ISD::FP_TO_SINT and ISD::FP_TO_UINT operations are not configured to promote MVT::i16 to MVT::i32 on VI targets with 16-bit integer support. Because the hardware lacks native instructions to convert 32-bit floats directly to 16-bit integers, compiling fptosi or fptoui to i16 triggers a fatal instruction selection failure.

In CastSequenceVisitor::VisitStmt (clang-tools-extra/clang-tidy/modernize/UseNullptrCheck.cpp), the AST visitor fails to unwrap inner cast expressions within CXXDefaultArgExpr and fails to ignore existing CXXNullPtrLiteralExpr nodes. Consequently, modernize-use-nullptr fails to identify and transform null pointer default arguments in function declarations when traversed via default argument expressions.

In ConstantFoldFP (llvm/lib/Analysis/ConstantFolding.cpp), atan2(+/-0.0, +/-0.0) calls are constant-folded even in contexts requiring preservation of floating-point exceptions and errno, violating floating-point exception preservation semantics.

In MachOPlatform::pushInitializersLoop (llvm/lib/ExecutionEngine/Orc/MachOPlatform.cpp), initializer lookup assumes all JITDylibs are managed by the platform, triggering fatal errors when encountering bare unmanaged JITDylibs created for preloaded dynamic libraries.
In PyValue::getOwner (mlir/lib/Bindings/Python/IRCore.cpp), not all control paths return a value, causing compilation errors on compilers like MSVC that enforce returns on non-void functions.

In captureInLambda (clang/lib/Sema/SemaExpr.cpp), checking variable initializers for bitfield expressions causes regular local variables initialized from bitfields to be falsely diagnosed as bitfield reference captures, rejecting valid lambda captures.

In getKeywordStatusHelper (clang/lib/Basic/IdentifierTable.cpp), char8_t is assigned KS_Future status in C mode instead of only C++ mode, triggering an assertion failure because C mode lacks future keyword diagnostic support for char8_t.

In InterpSection and BuildIdSection (lld/ELF/SyntheticSections.cpp), synthetic input sections representing .interp and .note.gnu.build-id are initialized without marking this->Live = true. When linking ELF executables with section garbage collection (--gc-sections), the linker treats these essential sections as unused and discards them from the output binary.

In AMDGPUTargetLowering::PerformDAGCombine (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/AMDGPUISelLowering.cpp), simplifyI24 is called on operand 1 immediately after operand 0 without checking if operand 0's simplification succeeded. If simplifying operand 0 replaces and deletes N, the second call dereferences the deleted node, resulting in a use-after-free crash during DAG combination.

In TreeTransform::TransformStmtExpr (clang/lib/Sema/TreeTransform.h), statement expression rebuild is bypassed when sub-statement pointers are unchanged, failing to update the isInstantiationDependent flag during template instantiation and leaving instantiated nodes marked dependent.

In X86TargetLowering::LowerSELECT (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), lowering soft fp16 select operations hardcodes scalar types MVT::f16 and MVT::i16 in bitcasts, causing compiler crashes when lowering select instructions on vectors of fp16.

In CGDebugInfo::CreateType (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGDebugInfo.cpp), VAT->getSizeExpr() is dereferenced directly without null checking when calculating array bounds for debug info. In function prototypes with unspecified variable-length array bounds (e.g., int[][*]), getSizeExpr() returns null, leading to a null pointer dereference crash.

In ModuleDepCollector::handleMakeArgs (clang/lib/Tooling/DependencyScanning/ModuleDepCollector.cpp), processing -MT options without explicit targets omits target arguments required by -cc1, and splitting empty target strings produces non-empty lists containing empty strings.

In DWARFExpressionList::Evaluate (lldb/source/Expression/DWARFExpressionList.cpp), evaluating an address that has no matching entry returns false without setting an error string in error_ptr, leaving expression evaluation failures without diagnostic explanation.

In FormatTokenLexer::readRawTokenVerilogSpecific (clang/lib/Format/FormatTokenLexer.cpp), Tok.setLength is called before Tok.setKind, causing setLength's assertion to inspect an uninitialized token kind field and triggering undefined behavior or assertion failures.

In Sema::ActOnUninitializedDecl (clang/lib/Sema/SemaDecl.cpp), checking whether a constexpr variable declaration is a definition does not check Var->isThisDeclarationADemotedDefinition(). When duplicate definitions of a constexpr variable template are merged across modules and one is demoted, Clang falsely diagnoses the declaration as missing a definition, rejecting valid modular code.

In ScopBuilder::ensureValueRead (polly/lib/Analysis/ScopBuilder.cpp), reading a PHI node defined outside a SCoP changes the memory access kind from MK_Value to MK_ExitPHI. Because exit PHI reads are only valid implicitly after SCoP execution, this misclassification confuses Polly's code generator in createExitPHINodeMerges, leading to assertion failures during code generation.

In Sema::CreateGenericSelectionExpr (clang/lib/Sema/SemaExpr.cpp), checking type compatibility for generic selection expressions compares ControllingExpr->getType() instead of its canonical type, causing deduced types such as __auto_type to match multiple incompatible associations and triggering false ambiguity errors.

In NoLintDirectiveHandler::Impl::diagHasNoLintInMacro (clang-tools-extra/clang-tidy/NoLintDirectiveHandler.cpp), macro location traversal uses getImmediateMacroCallerLoc instead of getImmediateExpansionRange().getBegin(), jumping to the caller expansion site rather than the argument expansion location and failing to detect NOLINT directives attached to macro arguments.

In isSWTestOp (llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCISelDAGToDAG.cpp), inspecting the constant value of operand 0 proceeds without checking that the node opcode is ISD::INTRINSIC_WO_CHAIN, mistakenly identifying arbitrary non-intrinsic nodes whose first operand matches an intrinsic ID as software test operations and attempting invalid branch folding.

In WriteBlockInfo (llvm/lib/Bitcode/Writer/BitcodeWriter.cpp), populating FUNC_CODE_BLOCKADDR_USERS only inspects direct users of BlockAddress constants, failing to identify functions that use block addresses indirectly through ConstantExpr or constant aggregates and causing BitcodeReader to omit necessary function materialization during LTO.

In DeclPrinter::VisitUsingDecl (clang/lib/AST/DeclPrinter.cpp), pretty-printing a using-declaration for an inherited constructor outputs the using-declaration's own name rather than inspecting ConstructorUsingShadowDecl for the nominated base class. This causes the AST printer to emit the derived class name instead of the base constructor name (e.g., printing using A::B; instead of using A::A;).

In CounterCoverageMappingBuilder::VisitSwitchStmt (clang/lib/CodeGen/CoverageMappingGen.cpp), the coverage region for a switch statement's exit counter is pushed with source locations spanning the switch statement itself (getStart(S) to getEnd(S)). Because the exit counter tracks execution continuing after the switch, attributing this counter to the switch statement body corrupts code coverage mapping metrics.

In InstCombiner::SimplifyDemandedVectorElts (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineSimplifyDemanded.cpp), simplifying a shufflevector instruction with a constant vector into an insertelement instruction uses the source element mask index rather than the destination vector lane index for the insertion. This inserts the constant value into an incorrect vector lane, causing silent miscompilation.

In SymbolFileNativePDB::GetFileIndex (lldb/source/Plugins/SymbolFile/NativePDB/SymbolFileNativePDB.cpp), file indices are cached in a class-level map keyed solely by compiland-local file_id, causing file index queries across different compilands to retrieve mismatched support file indices from earlier compilands.

In UnnamedGlobalConstantDecl::UnnamedGlobalConstantDecl (clang/lib/AST/DeclCXX.cpp), constructing the declaration with an APValue fails to register the value with ASTContext::addDestruction, preventing heap-allocated buffers within the APValue from being freed upon AST destruction.

In R600TargetLowering::PerformDAGCombine (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/R600ISelLowering.cpp), combining ISD::EXTRACT_VECTOR_ELT across a ISD::BITCAST fed by ISD::BUILD_VECTOR bypasses the bitcast without verifying that the source and destination vector types have the same number of elements. When bitcasting between vectors of differing lane counts, this causes the wrong vector element to be extracted, resulting in miscompilation.

In BssSection::writeTo (lld/ELF/SyntheticSections.h), writeTo unconditionally executes llvm_unreachable under the assumption that BSS sections are never written, triggering a crash whenever a linker script assigns COMMON symbols backed by BssSection to an SHT_PROGBITS output section.

In AMDGPUTargetLowering::getImplicitParameterOffset (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/AMDGPUISelLowering.cpp), the starting offset for implicit parameters is computed from MFI->getABIArgOffset() without aligning to a 4-byte boundary. If the explicit kernel arguments end at an unaligned byte boundary, subsequent implicit arguments queried via llvm.amdgcn.implicitarg.ptr are loaded from misaligned offsets, resulting in corrupted argument values.

In InstCombiner::foldICmpOrConstant (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineCompares.cpp), folding icmp eq (or (ptrtoint P), (ptrtoint Q)), 0 creates a single null constant with type P->getType() for both comparisons. If P and Q have different pointer types, comparing Q against P's null pointer type violates type agreement and triggers an assertion failure in CreateICmp.

In CodeGenFunction::EmitX86BuiltinExpr (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGBuiltin.cpp), lowering _mm256_broadcast_pd and _mm256_broadcast_ps specifies a 16-byte alignment instead of 1 byte when loading 128-bit sub-vectors. Because these broadcast intrinsics allow unaligned memory operands, enforcing 16-byte alignment generates aligned load instructions that crash with general protection faults when accessing unaligned pointers.

In ARMTargetLowering::shouldExpandAtomicLoadInIR (llvm/lib/Target/ARM/ARMISelLowering.cpp), 64-bit atomic loads are expanded to AtomicExpansionKind::LLOnly solely based on !Subtarget->isMClass(), attempting to generate ldrexd intrinsics on older ARM (pre-v6) and Thumb (pre-v7) architectures that lack 64-bit load-exclusive support and crashing instruction selection.

In RuntimeDyldImpl::emitCommonSymbols (llvm/lib/ExecutionEngine/RuntimeDyld/RuntimeDyld.cpp), common symbol emission is skipped if Resolver.findSymbolInLogicalDylib(Name) returns any symbol, without verifying whether the symbol is a strong definition. When multiple object files define the same common symbol, the symbol is skipped as redundant and never materialized in the JIT, resulting in undefined symbol errors.

In Sema::getVersionForDecl (clang/lib/Sema/SemaDeclAttr.cpp), the version returned for an annotated declaration is not clamped to the platform minimum version (getPlatformMinVersion()). When a function annotated with an introduction version older than the platform minimum calls an API introduced before the platform minimum, Clang emits false-positive -Wpartial-availability warnings.

In DeviceRTLTy::loadBinary (openmp/libomptarget/plugins/cuda/src/rtl.cpp), loaded CUDA modules are stored in a single-element-per-device vector Modules[DeviceId] rather than a list of modules, causing subsequent module loads on the same device to overwrite earlier CUmodule handles and leak device module resources upon deinitialization.

In LinkerDriver::link (lld/ELF/Driver.cpp), addWrappedSymbols is invoked after parallelForEach(objectFiles, postParseObjectFile), allowing --wrap symbols to extract new object files from archives after post-parse local symbol initialization has already completed and leaving local symbol tables in newly extracted objects uninitialized.

In TuneExynosM4 (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64.td), the SubtargetFeature name string is defined as "exynosm3" rather than "exynosm4", preventing the driver and backend from recognizing -mtune=exynos-m4 and activating Exynos-M4 specific machine scheduling and instruction fusion features.

In X86FrameLowering::mergeSPUpdates and X86ExpandPseudo::ExpandMI (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86FrameLowering.cpp), two-pass tail call sequence generation fails to recognize and merge stack adjustments in all cases. This causes argument push instructions for the tail callee to be emitted before restoring callee-saved registers or popping the frame, clobbering the return address on the stack.

In clang/lib/Headers/emmintrin.h (and related AVX headers), _mm_slli_si128 and _mm_srli_si128 evaluate __builtin_shufflevector indices using 16 - (char)(imm) unconditionally within the shuffle argument list. When the immediate shift count is greater than or equal to 16, the resulting indices fall outside the valid vector element range, causing __builtin_shufflevector to fail semantic validation with a compilation error.

In peelOffOuterExpr (clang/lib/StaticAnalyzer/Core/BugReporterVisitors.cpp), resolving an Objective-C property getter inside a PseudoObjectExpr hardcodes access to semantic expression index 1. For class properties and super property accessors that contain only a single semantic expression, this hardcoded index triggers an out-of-bounds vector access assertion failure or crash.

In ASTContext::getTargetAddressSpace (clang/lib/AST/ASTContext.cpp), querying the address space of a function type unconditionally returns getProgramAddressSpace() without checking T.hasAddressSpace(), causing explicit address space qualifiers such as __ptr32 on function pointers to be ignored.

In CodeGenFunction::EmitCallArg (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGCall.cpp), registering argument cleanup deactivation passes EHStack.getInnermostEHScope() instead of EHStack.stable_begin(), resolving to an enclosing EHTerminateScope when exception cleanups are disabled in noexcept functions and crashing during call argument emission under the Microsoft C++ ABI.

In NVPTXTargetInfo (clang/lib/Basic/Targets.cpp), setSupportedOpenCLOpts is not implemented to register supported OpenCL extensions on the NVPTX target. Consequently, all optional core OpenCL features and extensions (such as cl_khr_fp64 and atomic extensions) default to disabled, causing valid OpenCL code and libclc compilation targeting NVPTX to fail.

In Fuzzer::TryDetectingAMemoryLeak (llvm/lib/Fuzzer/FuzzerLoop.cpp), invoking RunOneAndUpdateCorpus while evaluating memory leaks can append newly discovered inputs to the main corpus std::vector. This reallocation invalidates active corpus iterators in enclosing loops, resulting in a use-after-free crash when the loop attempts to access the next corpus element.

In X86InstrInfo::copyPhysReg (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86InstrInfo.cpp), the fallback register liveness check for preserving EFLAGS only queries AX in LivePhysRegs. Because it does not check whether subregisters of AX (such as AL or AH) are currently live, it erroneously treats AX as dead and overwrites it, clobbering live subregister values.

In populateComplexToLLVMConversionPatterns (mlir/lib/Conversion/ComplexToLLVM/ComplexToLLVM.cpp), conversion patterns for complex.constant operations are omitted, causing MLIR dialect conversion from complex to LLVM to fail whenever complex constants are encountered.

In DILocalVariable::DILocalVariable (llvm/include/llvm/IR/DebugInfoMetadata.h), the range assertions for Flags and Arg check that values are strictly less than (1 << 16) - 1 instead of (1 << 16). This off-by-one bound triggers false-positive assertion failures in debug builds when a valid 16-bit mask or argument index with value 0xFFFF is used.

In CategorizedHelpPrinter::printOptions (llvm/lib/Support/CommandLine.cpp), verifying category validity queries CategorizedOptions.count(Cat) on a map that is initially empty instead of checking SortedCategories, triggering an assertion failure whenever command-line help options are printed in assert builds.

In ASTWriterStmt::VisitCXXUuidofExpr and ASTReaderStmt::VisitCXXUuidofExpr (clang/lib/Serialization/ASTWriterStmt.cpp and ASTReaderStmt.cpp), the UUID string attribute of a CXXUuidofExpr is not serialized to or deserialized from AST bitcode. When loading AST or PCH files containing __uuidof expressions, the expression lacks GUID data, causing missing symbol definitions or crashes during code generation.

In InputSectionBase::adjustSplitStackFunctionPrologues (lld/ELF/InputSection.cpp), relocation inspection skips symbols where isLocal() is true, failing to adjust split-stack function prologues when calling non-split-stack functions with hidden visibility whose symbols were localized after symbol resolution.

In CXXRecordDecl and Sema::ActOnUninitializedDecl (clang/include/clang/AST/DeclCXX.h), validating const object declarations without initializers relies on hasUserProvidedDefaultConstructor(). Because constructor templates with variadic or default parameters (e.g., template<typename ...T> X(T...)) are not classified as default constructors by hasUserProvidedDefaultConstructor, Clang incorrectly rejects valid const objects of such types with compilation errors.

In optimizeOnceStoredGlobal (llvm/lib/Transforms/IPO/GlobalOpt.cpp), values matching isMallocLikeFn are unconditionally cast using cast<CallInst>, triggering a bad-cast assertion failure when an allocation function is invoked via an InvokeInst.

In compiler-rt/lib/sanitizer_common/sanitizer_common_interceptors.inc, the setbuffer interceptor defines its third parameter as int mode instead of SIZE_T size and unpoisons fixed __sanitizer_bufsiz bytes, causing parameter truncation on 64-bit platforms and incorrect shadow memory tracking.

In Sema::SetDeclDefaulted (clang/lib/Sema/SemaDeclCXX.cpp), defaulted comparison checks inside record lexical contexts return early without verifying that RD->isCompleteDefinition() is false, omitting parameter type verification for defaulted out-of-class comparisons on complete classes.

In ExpressionEvaluationContextRecord::isDiscardedStatementContext (clang/include/clang/Sema/Sema.h), all nested evaluation contexts inside discarded statements are considered discarded, preventing return type deduction for nested function calls inside if constexpr (false) blocks and causing false compilation errors.

In determinePointerAccessAttrs (llvm/lib/Transforms/IPO/FunctionAttrs.cpp), inspecting StoreInst uses fails to verify whether the pointer is the stored value operand rather than the destination pointer, mistakenly inferring writeonly attributes on pointers that are captured into memory and later read.

In needToInsertPhisForLCSSA (llvm/lib/Transforms/Utils/LoopUnroll.cpp), the check to determine whether loop unrolling necessitates LCSSA PHI reconstruction only checks whether operand definitions belong to the immediate parent loop (LI->getLoopFor(Def->getParent()) == L). For definitions in outer enclosing loops that are used outside the unrolled loop, this check returns false and skips PHI creation, leaving the IR in broken LCSSA form and triggering verifier assertion failures.

In SIInsertWaits::isOpRelevant (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SIInsertWaits.cpp), determining whether an instruction operand is the value being stored assumes the data operand precedes the address operand for all instructions except DS operations. Because flat_store operands have address before data, isOpRelevant fails to identify the data register, omitting necessary s_waitcnt synchronization instructions and causing hardware data races.

In LoopVectorizationPlanner::buildVPlanWithVPRecipes (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp), induction recipes for truncated induction variables are moved to the header block upon creation rather than after first-order recurrence sinking, breaking instruction relative ordering assumptions and causing compiler crashes.

In SCEVExpander::expand (llvm/lib/Analysis/ScalarEvolutionExpander.cpp), checking whether to bypass cached value reuse from ExprValueMap for scAddRecExpr only tests LSRMode rather than checking !CanonicalMode. When CanonicalMode is disabled by passes like IndVarSimplify, SCEVExpander reuses non-PHI values instead of generating literal recurrence PHI nodes, violating IndVarSimplify's structural invariants and causing optimization failures.

In TargetInfo::getRealTypeByWidth (clang/lib/Basic/TargetInfo.cpp), FloatModeKind::LongDouble is unconditionally returned when ExplicitType is LongDouble without verifying that the target long double format is 128-bit, improperly selecting 80-bit x86_fp80 for mode(TC) complex numbers on x86_64.

In ProcessGDBRemote::BuildDynamicRegisterInfo (lldb/source/Plugins/Process/gdb-remote/ProcessGDBRemote.cpp), the generic register XML attribute is parsed using value.getAsInteger() instead of Args::StringToGenericRegister(), causing string register identifiers like "pc" and "sp" to fail parsing and leaving generic register mappings uninitialized.

In Parser::ParseCastExpression (clang/lib/Parse/ParseExpr.cpp), recursively parsing the operand of a prefix increment or decrement operator forwards the outer isTypeCast parameter instead of passing NotTypeCast. When an increment operator is nested within a type cast (such as (int)++(x)), its parenthesized operand is erroneously parsed as a ParenListExpr rather than a ParenExpr, triggering assertion failures during semantic analysis.

In SelectionDAG (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/SelectionDAG.cpp), folding constant offsets during address computation improperly commutes operands, leading to silent miscompilations in consumer-lame benchmark.

In ObjFile::registerCompactUnwind (lld/MachO/InputFiles.cpp), segment validation is omitted when registering compact unwind relocations, failing to verify that referent input sections reside in the __TEXT segment and allowing invalid non-text relocations to pass without error.

In convertDenseElementsAttr (mlir/lib/Target/LLVMIR/ModuleTranslation.cpp), constructing a sequential constant for a DenseElementsAttr proceeds without checking if getNumElements() == 0, triggering division by zero or invalid constant construction when translating 1-dimensional zero-element tensors to LLVM IR.

In ASTReader::ReadControlBlock (clang/lib/Serialization/ASTReader.cpp), F.ImportLoc is passed to HeaderSearch::lookupModule before F.ImportLoc has been read and initialized from the AST stream, violating SourceLocation validity invariants and triggering an assertion failure.
In Clang CodeGen (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGDebugInfo.cpp), building debug info for a typedef'd anonymous tag type eagerly emits incomplete debug records, causing duplicate and corrupted type definitions.

In AMDGPU target lowering (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SIISelLowering.cpp), non-uniform constant address space loads are lowered to flat loads without proper synchronization, causing instruction selection failures.

In ScalarEvolution::getAddExpr (llvm/lib/Analysis/ScalarEvolution.cpp), nowrap flags computed for an inner addrec scope are improperly propagated to an outer SCEV addition expression without ensuring that entry into the outer scope guarantees execution of the inner scope.

In LICM (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/LICM.cpp), promoteLoopAccessesToScalars fails to verify the presence of catchswitch blocks before promoting memory accesses, triggering assertion crashes in exception handling code.

In InstCombinerImpl::visitSelectInst (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineSelect.cpp), folding (select C, (gep Ptr, Idx), Ptr) produces malformed select instructions when condition C is a vector type but Idx is a scalar type.
In MC COFF object writer (llvm/lib/MC/WinCOFFObjectWriter.cpp), support for reproducible COFF timestamps is improperly gated, causing inconsistent timestamp emission in object headers.
In WinEH preparation (llvm/lib/CodeGen/WinEHPrepare.cpp), llvm.x86.seh.recoverfp fails to adjust from RSP-after-prologue to RBP on x64, breaking SEH filter access to parent frame variables.
In CoverageExporterLcov.cpp (llvm/tools/llvm-cov/CoverageExporterLcov.cpp), the LCOV branch coverage exporter emits the branch hit summary field as 'BFH' instead of the standard 'BRH' record name.

In SelectionDAG (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/DAGCombiner.cpp), MergeConsecutiveStores reorders consecutive store instructions across potential aliasing barriers, causing memory corruption (PR25154).
In PowerPC backend (llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCAsmPrinter.cpp), printing assembly for bootstrapped compiler instances accesses uninitialized subtarget features, causing stage2 bootstrap crashes.

In SelectMapping (compiler-rt/lib/tsan/rtl/tsan_platform.h), checking defined(SANITIZER_IOSSIM) rather than its boolean value causes the iOS simulator memory mapping to be incorrectly selected even when targeting real iOS devices.

In TargetLowering::expandISNAN (llvm/lib/CodeGen/SelectionDAG/TargetLowering.cpp), expanding isnan for ppc_fp128 through integer operations causes compiler failures because integer operations of that bit width are illegal on 32-bit PowerPC targets.

In initializeProfileForContinuousMode (compiler-rt/lib/profile/InstrProfilingFile.c), POSIX-specific ftello and unsupported MAP_FIXED flags are referenced on Windows, causing compilation errors and runtime failures.
In LLDB PluginManager (lldb/source/Core/PluginManager.cpp), initializing plugin settings without checking for null debugger instances causes a null pointer dereference crash.

In ScriptedProcessPythonInterface.h (lldb/source/Plugins/ScriptInterpreter/Python/ScriptedProcessPythonInterface.h), GetGenericInteger is declared with return type llvm::Optional<uint64_t> while its definition specifies llvm::Optional<unsigned long long>, causing compilation failure on platforms where uint64_t and unsigned long long are distinct types.

In SimplifyLibCalls (llvm/lib/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyLibCalls.cpp), optimizing fortified library functions inserts replacement instructions before the original call, violating basic block dominance invariants.

In ScalarEvolution::isImpliedCond (llvm/lib/Analysis/ScalarEvolution.cpp), attempting to truncate pointer-typed operands to narrower types during implied condition analysis triggers an assertion failure because ScalarEvolution forbids pointer truncation.
In LLD COFF (lld/COFF/ICF.cpp), identical code folding fails to recognize that relocations referring to the same symbol across sections are identical, preventing valid COMDAT folding.

In CGDebugInfo::collectFunctionDeclProps (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGDebugInfo.cpp), checking for FunctionProtoType rather than calling hasPrototype causes the FlagPrototyped debug info flag to be erroneously set on K&R function definitions.

In MemoryTagManager.h (lldb/include/lldb/Target/MemoryTagManager.h), TagRange is defined as Range<lldb::addr_t, size_t> rather than Range<lldb::addr_t, lldb::addr_t>, causing compilation errors on 32-bit architectures where size_t is narrower than 64-bit addr_t.

In combineTargetShuffle (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), folding broadcast(bitcast(src)) into bitcast(broadcast(src)) without validating that the source type is a legal vector element type causes compiler crashes on types like x86_mmx.

In addEntriesForFunctionsWithoutUnwindInfo (lld/MachO/UnwindInfoSection.cpp), absolute symbols have a null input section pointer (d->isec), which is dereferenced directly without null checking, causing a segmentation fault during unwind info generation.
In ObjFile::parseSymbols (lld/MachO/InputFiles.cpp), symbolOffset is declared as uint64_t instead of size_t, causing compilation errors on 32-bit platforms when slicing section data.

In X86FrameLowering (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86FrameLowering.cpp), the prologue omits the Swift async context frame setup on Win64 while the epilogue executes the corresponding frame teardown, creating an unbalanced stack frame that crashes at runtime.

In getRelocationResolver (llvm/lib/Object/RelocationResolver.cpp), BPF data relocations are checked against obsolete R_BPF_64_64 and R_BPF_64_32 relocation types instead of R_BPF_64_ABS64 and R_BPF_64_ABS32, preventing tools like llvm-readobj from resolving relocations in BPF ELF objects.

In BasicAAResult::aliasPHI (llvm/lib/Analysis/BasicAliasAnalysis.cpp), querying alias information on a PHI node with zero incoming values attempts to unwrap an uninitialized Optional value, triggering an assertion failure.
In Clang CodeGen (clang/lib/CodeGen/CGExpr.cpp), removing casts in __builtin_object_size ignores implicit pointer arithmetic in cast kinds, miscalculating object sizes at runtime.

In LinkerDriver::maybeExportMinGWSymbols (lld/COFF/Driver.cpp), exported symbols from comdats are not marked as GC roots, causing unreferenced comdat sections to be omitted during garbage collection and leaving exported symbol RVAs as zero.

In TargetLoweringObjectFileELF::getSectionForLSDA (llvm/lib/CodeGen/TargetLoweringObjectFileImpl.cpp), the IsComdat argument to getELFSection is determined solely by F.hasComdat(), erroneously assigning COMDAT section group flags to LSDA sections belonging to non-COMDAT group types.

In TreeTransform::TransformAttributedStmt (clang/lib/Sema/TreeTransform.h), null attributes returned when attribute transformation fails during template instantiation are appended to the attribute list without null checking, causing compiler crashes in BuildAttributedStmt.
In libclang (clang/tools/libclang/CXType.cpp), clang_getCanonicalType returns the underlying un-deduced auto type instead of the deduced type for auto variables.

In SIRegisterInfo::spillSGPR and restoreSGPR (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SIRegisterInfo.cpp), the RegScavenger pointer RS is unconditionally dereferenced when constructing SGPRSpillBuilder, resulting in undefined behavior and UBSan null reference binding errors when RS is null.

In TGParser::ParseTemplateArgValueList (llvm/lib/TableGen/TGParser.cpp), a missing comma between template arguments causes the parser to return false without diagnosing the error, causing TableGen to silently terminate with a non-zero exit code.

In BuildInputAnnotations (llvm/utils/FileCheck/FileCheck.cpp), the CompareSMLoc comparator functor omits a const qualifier on its operator() method, triggering static assertion failures during compilation with GCC 9 and C++17.

In sortPtrAccesses (llvm/lib/Analysis/LoopAccessAnalysis.cpp), calling getPointersDiff with StrictCheck defaulted to false truncates pointer byte distances not evenly divisible by element size, leading to invalid pointer ordering and vectorization miscompiles.
In llvm_ocaml.c (llvm/bindings/ocaml/llvm/llvm_ocaml.c), calling caml_alloc_initialized_string causes link failures on systems with older OCaml runtimes that lack this function.

In ARM target lowering (llvm/lib/Target/ARM/ARMISelLowering.cpp), ReconstructShuffle assumes EXTRACT_VECTOR_ELT only accepts constant indices, aborting the compiler when encountering variable indices.

In DWARFExpression::Evaluate (lldb/source/Expression/DWARFExpression.cpp), dereferencing a Scalar value under DW_OP_deref fails to promote the value type to LoadAddress, causing subsequent memory operations to treat the address as a raw scalar and fail evaluation.
In GDBRemoteCommunicationClient.cpp (lldb), querying symbols of unknown type through qSymbol on non-MachO targets causes symbol resolution failures for linker-script-generated symbols.

In AArch64TargetLowering::AArch64TargetLowering (llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64ISelLowering.cpp), scalable vector types do not specify Expand for MULHS, MULHU, SMUL_LOHI, or UMUL_LOHI, causing instruction selection crashes when DAGCombiner produces these nodes for scalable vector constant division.

In SIMCCodeEmitter::encodeInstruction (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/MCTargetDesc/SIMCCodeEmitter.cpp), literal 1ul is shifted by 59 and 60 bits, causing undefined behavior and compilation errors on Windows where unsigned long is 32 bits.

In BitcodeReader::parseFunctionBody (llvm/lib/Bitcode/Reader/BitcodeReader.cpp), the alignment attribute for atomicrmw instructions is decoded from hardcoded index Record[6] instead of Record[OpNum + 4], reading incorrect record fields during bitcode parsing.

In LoopUnswitch::emitPreheaderBranchOnCondition (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/LoopUnswitch.cpp), updating MemorySSA for duplicated preheader instructions fails to traverse non-clobbering MemoryDefs inside the loop body, causing MemorySSA verification crashes.

In ARMFastISel::ARMMaterializeGV (llvm/lib/Target/ARM/ARMFastISel.cpp), global variable materialization relies on shouldAssumeDSOLocal on ELF targets without checking if the symbol is in the GOT, generating redundant indirect loads that crash at runtime.
In SemaExprCXX.cpp (clang), dependent local class instantiation omits setting the TypeSourceInfo of the destructor, causing a null pointer dereference crash during template instantiation.
In Flang.cpp (clang), preprocessing fixed-form Fortran source fails to retain space formatting, causing flang -fc1 to misparse fixed-form code.
In AArch64ISelLowering.cpp (llvm/Target/AArch64), sub with carry lowers with an inverted outgoing carry flag, causing incorrect arithmetic results in multi-word subtraction.
In ObjCARCOpts.cpp (llvm/Transforms/ObjCARC), failing to track PHI nodes discovered to be non-null causes ARC optimization to improperly eliminate retain/release calls.

In AAResults (llvm/include/llvm/Analysis/AliasAnalysis.h), member variable Depth lacks an in-class initializer and constructor initialization, leading to uninitialized memory reads during recursion depth checks.

In MoveForStackify (llvm/lib/Target/WebAssembly/WebAssemblyRegStackify.cpp), instruction DefI is accessed to inspect multivalue definitions after potentially being deleted by rematerializeCheapDef, triggering access to freed memory and compiler crashes.

In PPCTargetLowering::getSqrtInputTest (llvm/lib/Target/PowerPC/PPCISelLowering.cpp), an EXTRACT_SUBREG machine node of type MVT::i1 is generated without verifying whether MVT::i1 is a legal type. On PowerPC targets where condition register bit representations are disabled (-crbits), this produces an illegal type during DAG combination and causes instruction selection failures.
In CGDeclCXX.cpp (clang), emitting shutdown-time destructors for static local variables with trivial destructors causes unnecessary runtime overhead and registration leaks.

In BoUpSLP::vectorizeTree (llvm/lib/Transforms/Vectorize/SLPVectorizer.cpp), masked gather intrinsics are created using the alignment of only the first load in the scatter bundle rather than the minimum alignment across all gathered loads. This causes overaligned gather operations to be emitted for scattered loads with varying alignments, leading to potential alignment violations and miscompilation.

In ObjCARCOpt::OptimizeReturns (llvm/lib/Transforms/ObjCARC/ObjCARCOpts.cpp), skipping non-tail-call retainRV/autoreleaseRV pairs via continue fails to clear the DependingInstructions and Visited tracking sets. Consequently, stale instructions and blocks persist across loop iterations, preventing subsequent eligible retainRV/autoreleaseRV pairs from being optimized.
In WebAssemblyISelLowering.cpp (llvm/Target/WebAssembly), optimizing select instructions combined with bitwise-AND performs invalid operand transformations, resulting in silent miscompilation.

In IdentifierNamingCheck::getStyleForFile (clang-tools-extra/clang-tidy/readability/IdentifierNamingCheck.cpp), an extraneous assert(false) statement precedes the fallback default style construction. When checking files whose parent directory naming styles are not yet cached, clang-tidy aborts with an assertion failure in debug builds.

In clang/include/clang-c/Index.h, CXCursor_CXXAddrspaceCastExpr was inserted into the middle of the CXCursorKind enumeration rather than at the end. This shifted the numeric values of 23 existing cursor kind enumerators, breaking public C API binary compatibility (ABI) for external libclang consumers.
In AMDGPUISelDAGToDAG.cpp (llvm/Target/AMDGPU), operand matching for vector bit operations fails to validate register classes, causing instruction selection crashes.

In JumpThreadingPass::MaybeThreadThroughTwoBasicBlocks (llvm/lib/Transforms/Scalar/JumpThreading.cpp), basic blocks ending in unconditional branches are not rejected when attempting to thread jumps across two blocks. Subsequent processing in ThreadThroughTwoBasicBlocks assumes a conditional branch and attempts to access the second successor via getSuccessor(1), causing an out-of-bounds indexing crash.
In VarDecl.cpp (clang), failing to reset un-evaluated constant flags for const structs and arrays in C++ mode causes subsequent constant evaluation to use stale values.

In SIRegisterInfo::getReservedRegs (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SIRegisterInfo.cpp), reserving VGPRs allocated for SGPR spilling is guarded by VGPRReservedForSGPRSpill, causing them to be skipped when a VGPR is used for spilling without being speculatively reserved. This leaves the spill VGPRs unmarked in the reserved register mask, allowing register allocation to clobber them and corrupt runtime execution.
In RISCVFrameLowering.cpp (llvm/Target/RISCV), outlining CFI instructions when they are needed for stack unwinding leads to broken unwinding frames and unwinder aborts.

In Sema::FindCompositePointerType (clang/lib/Sema/SemaExprCXX.cpp), computing the composite pointer type between void* and a pointer to an Objective-C lifetime-qualified pointer treats differing lifetime qualifiers as incompatible and returns a null QualType. This causes Clang to reject valid pointer comparisons with a bogus comparison of distinct pointer types diagnostic in Objective-C++ ARC mode.

In PointerReplacer::replace (llvm/lib/Transforms/InstCombine/InstCombineLoadStoreAlloca.cpp), replacing instructions in the copy-constant-to-alloca optimization repeatedly creates and re-inserts redundant bitcasts for the original memcpy operands on each iteration. This repeatedly marks the IR as modified without reaching a fixed point, causing InstCombine to enter an infinite loop.
In BasicBlockUtils.cpp (llvm/Transforms/Utils), MergeBlockIntoPredecessor inadvertently discards dbg.value intrinsics, dropping variable location debug information.
In ByteCodeExprGen.cpp (clang/bytecode), evaluating constructor calls on external RVO pointers is rejected, causing evaluation failures in the experimental constant interpreter.

In GCOVProfiling.cpp (llvm/lib/Transforms/Instrumentation/GCOVProfiling.cpp), the Blocks container in GCOVFunction was changed to a DenseMap keyed by BasicBlock pointers. Iterating over this unordered map when emitting arcs and writing function records causes block ordering and checksum calculations to depend non-deterministically on pointer addresses.
In ParseExpr.cpp (clang), trailing comma parsing in expression lists inadvertently permits invalid syntax across general expression contexts without diagnostic errors.

In Parser::parse (clang-tools-extra/clangd/ConfigYAML.cpp), the top-level YAML configuration parser omits registering a handler for the Index section. As a result, any Index configuration directives (such as background indexing options) present in user YAML configuration files are silently ignored.
In MachineLICM.cpp (llvm/CodeGen), preliminary hoisting of COPY instructions occurs even when the user instruction cannot be hoisted, increasing register pressure unnecessarily.
In StackProtector.cpp (llvm/CodeGen), inserting redundant stack protector checks before noreturn calls causes unnecessary code bloat and register spills.
In SystemZISelLowering.cpp (llvm/Target/SystemZ), compiling code under #pragma pack(1) lowers misaligned memory operands to instructions requiring alignment, raising hardware exceptions.
In CGDeclCXX.cpp (clang), static local variables with trivial destructors are registered with __cxa_atexit, emitting unnecessary shutdown-time destructors.
In Policy.h, harden PolicyStack against cross-thread Guard misuse.
In AMDGPUISelDAGToDAG.cpp (llvm/Target/AMDGPU), matching vector bit operations fails to validate register operand constraints, causing instruction selection failure.
In SourceInfo.h (clang/bytecode), evaluating SourceInfo::Source without a null check dereferences null pointers in the experimental bytecode interpreter.
In Path.cpp, FileSystemTest for BSD semantics.

In SIFoldOperands::foldOperand (llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/SIFoldOperands.cpp), folding immediate copies whose destination is a physical register fails to check whether the destination register is physical before scanning its users. This causes the optimizer to iterate over all MachineRegisterInfo users of the physical register, incorrectly propagating immediate values into unrelated subsequent instructions and corrupting register values.
In Driver.cpp (lld/COFF), diagnosing undefined symbols before LTO prevents automatically importing data symbols from DLLs, triggering false undefined symbol errors.
In InstCombineSimplifyDemanded.cpp, mark select in fdiv transforms with unknown profile.

In llvm/lib/Target/AArch64/AArch64InstrInfo.td, instruction selection patterns are missing for the AArch64 Neon fcvtzs and fcvtzu intrinsics operating on single-element vector types (v1f64). Emitting calls to llvm.aarch64.neon.fcvtzs or llvm.aarch64.neon.fcvtzu with <1 x double> operands triggers an instruction selection failure and crashes the compiler.

In ASTNodeImporter::VisitPackExpansionType (clang/lib/AST/ASTImporter.cpp) and TypeProperties.td, deserializing or importing a PackExpansionType invokes getPackExpansionType without specifying ExpectPackInType as false. When processing a pack expansion type whose pattern contains no unexpanded parameter packs (such as in non-dependent pack expansions), ASTContext::getPackExpansionType triggers an assertion failure and crashes.
In SignalsTest.cpp, disable SignalsTest.PrintsSymbolizerMarkup.
In TestLoongArchEmulator.cpp, delete unused variables in TestLoongArchEmulator.cpp.

In MachineVerifier::visitMachineOperand (llvm/lib/CodeGen/MachineVerifier.cpp), NumDefs is set to the instruction's dynamic definition count for STATEPOINT opcodes. Because STATEPOINT possesses no static operand descriptors in MCInstrDesc, iterating over the dynamic defs accesses MCID.OpInfo beyond its allocated bounds, triggering memory errors and AddressSanitizer crashes.
In TelemetryTest.cpp, unit test compile failure with LLVM_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=0.

In LoopExtractor::runOnFunction (llvm/lib/Transforms/IPO/LoopExtractor.cpp), querying LoopInfoWrapperPass can invoke BreakCriticalEdges to modify the function's CFG, but the pass fails to capture whether the analysis modified the IR. If the function contains no loops to extract, runOnFunction returns false despite the CFG changes, violating pass manager invariants and causing assertion failures.
In DebugInfo.h, make OCaml MetadataKind type consistent with C API.
In ByteCodeExprGen.cpp (clang/bytecode), rejecting constructor calls on external RVO pointers causes evaluation failures in the constant interpreter.
In SandboxIRTest.cpp, failing unittest introduced by 51039101cf32.
In PythonTestSuite.cpp, SWIG wrapper compilation error.

In combineVectorCompareAndMaskUnaryOp (llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelLowering.cpp), combining vector integer-to-floating-point conversions with bitwise masks checks element bitwidths but omits verifying that the overall vector type size matches the operand size. When vector sizes differ (such as transforming a 256-bit <4 x i64> operand into a 128-bit <4 x float> result), the mismatched bitwidth causes DAG combiner type assertion failures and miscompilations.

In Attributor::run and Attributor::updateAA (llvm/lib/Transforms/IPO/Attributor.cpp), abstract attributes that are temporarily assumed dead are bypassed before updateAA is called, preventing them from recording their dependency on the liveness attribute. If the attribute's program point subsequently transitions to live, the attribute is never re-evaluated, resulting in incorrect fixed points and miscompilations where live calls are replaced with undef.
In DependencyScanningFilesystemTest.cpp, [test] Update reference to tracing VFS.
In FileSystemTest.cpp, test build failure.
In SystemZISelLowering.cpp (llvm/Target/SystemZ), compiling code under #pragma pack(1) lowers misaligned memory operands to aligned vector instructions, causing hardware traps.

In handleBuffer (llvm/tools/llvm-dwarfdump/llvm-dwarfdump.cpp), the boolean status Result is updated via compound assignment Result &= HandleObj(...) while the recoverable error callback passed into HandleObj concurrently modifies Result by reference. This causes an unsequenced read and write of the same scalar variable in an expression, resulting in undefined behavior.

In MachOReader::setSymbolInRelocationInfo and MachOWriter::writeSections (llvm/tools/llvm-objcopy/MachO/MachOReader.cpp and MachOWriter.cpp), plain relocation symbol indices are read and written directly through the MachO::relocation_info struct bitfields without accounting for endianness. When processing Mach-O files with mismatched host and target byte orders, the bitfield layout misaligns the 24-bit symbol index, writing corrupted relocation symbol numbers into the output binary.

In llvm/include/llvm/BinaryFormat/MachO.h, struct relocation_info conditionally alters its bitfield ordering under big-endian host definitions. This violates the standard Mach-O ABI specification in system headers where the bitfield layout remains fixed regardless of endianness, resulting in struct layout incompatibilities with platform headers and incorrect relocation parsing.

In ASTNodeImporter::VisitCompoundAssignOperator (clang/lib/AST/ASTImporter.cpp), ToComputationLHSType and ToComputationResultType are wrapped in duplicate importChecked calls despite having already been imported earlier in the method. Importing these types twice corrupts the ASTImporter source location cache and triggers an assertion failure in SourceManager::getFileIDLoaded during Cross-Translation-Unit (CTU) analysis.
